passages.title: Hari Budi
sentences: Nama saya Budi dan saya tinggal di Bandung.
My name is Budi and I live in Bandung.
Setiap hari saya bangun pukul enam pagi.
Every day I get up at six in the morning.
Saya mandi, lalu makan roti dan minum kopi.
I take a shower, then eat bread and drink coffee.
Saya bekerja di sebuah kantor di tengah kota.
I work in an office in the middle of the city.
Saya pergi ke kantor naik bus karena saya tidak punya mobil.
I go to the office by bus because I don't have a car.
Pada siang hari, saya makan nasi dengan teman-teman kantor.
At midday I eat rice with friends from the office.
Saya pulang ke rumah pukul lima sore.
I go home at five in the afternoon.
Malam hari, saya membaca buku atau menonton film sebelum tidur.
In the evening I read a book or watch a film before sleeping.

questions.q: Pukul berapa Budi bangun?
questions.en: What time does Budi get up?

questions.q: Budi pergi ke kantor dengan mobilnya.
questions.en: Budi goes to the office in his car.

questions.q: Dengan siapa Budi makan siang?
questions.en: Who does Budi have lunch with?

questions.q: Budi pulang pada sore hari.
questions.en: Budi goes home in the afternoon.

questions.q: Budi membaca buku di kantor setiap malam.
questions.en: Budi reads a book at the office every evening.

passages.title: Keluarga Sari
sentences: Umur Sari sepuluh tahun dan dia tinggal di Surabaya.
Sari is ten years old and she lives in Surabaya.
Di keluarganya ada lima orang.
There are five people in her family.
Ayahnya seorang dokter dan ibunya seorang guru bahasa Inggris.
Her father is a doctor and her mother is an English teacher.
Sari punya seorang kakak laki-laki, Andi, dan seorang adik perempuan, Nina.
Sari has an older brother, Andi, and a younger sister, Nina.
Umur Andi enam belas tahun dan dia sangat suka musik.
Andi is sixteen and he really likes music.
Nina masih kecil dan dia bermain dengan kucing setiap hari.
Nina is still small and she plays with the cat every day.
Pada hari Minggu, semua orang makan bersama di rumah.
On Sundays everyone eats together at home.
Sari senang karena ibunya memasak ayam yang enak.
Sari is happy because her mother cooks delicious chicken.

questions.q: Berapa orang ada di keluarga Sari?
questions.en: How many people are there in Sari's family?

questions.q: Apa pekerjaan ayah Sari?
questions.en: What is Sari's father's job?

questions.q: Andi adalah adik Sari.
questions.en: Andi is Sari's younger brother.

questions.q: Nina suka bermain dengan anjing.
questions.en: Nina likes playing with a dog.

questions.q: Keluarga Sari makan bersama pada hari Minggu.
questions.en: Sari's family eats together on Sunday.

passages.title: Di pasar
sentences: Pagi ini Ibu Wati pergi ke pasar dekat rumahnya.
This morning Mrs Wati goes to the market near her house.
"Selamat pagi, Bu. Mau beli apa?" tanya seorang bapak.
"Good morning, madam. What would you like to buy?" a man asks.
"Saya mau beli ikan dan sayur," jawab Ibu Wati.
"I want to buy fish and vegetables," Mrs Wati answers.
"Ikan ini enak dan tidak mahal," kata bapak itu.
"This fish is good and not expensive," the man says.
Ibu Wati membeli dua ekor ikan dan sedikit sayur hijau.
Mrs Wati buys two fish and a few green vegetables.
Dia juga mencari buah untuk anak-anaknya, tetapi buahnya sudah habis.
She also looks for fruit for her children, but the fruit has run out.
Harga semuanya lima puluh ribu.
The price of everything is fifty thousand.
Ibu Wati membayar, lalu pulang dengan senang.
Mrs Wati pays and then goes home happy.

questions.q: Ke mana Ibu Wati pergi pagi ini?
questions.en: Where does Mrs Wati go this morning?

questions.q: Menurut bapak itu, ikannya mahal.
questions.en: According to the man, the fish is expensive.

questions.q: Apa yang Ibu Wati beli?
questions.en: What does Mrs Wati buy?

questions.q: Ibu Wati tidak bisa membeli buah.
questions.en: Mrs Wati cannot buy fruit.

passages.title: Pesan untuk Rina
sentences: Halo Rina, ini Maya.
Hello Rina, this is Maya.
Kamu ada waktu besok sore?
Do you have time tomorrow afternoon?
Saya mau menonton film baru di kota.
I want to watch a new film in town.
Filmnya mulai pukul empat, jadi kita bisa bertemu di depan kantor pos pukul tiga.
The film starts at four, so we can meet in front of the post office at three.
Setelah film, kita bisa makan malam di rumah makan dekat sana.
After the film we can have dinner at a restaurant near there.
Kalau kamu tidak bisa datang, tolong telepon saya malam ini.
If you can't come, please call me tonight.
Nomor saya yang baru ada di bawah.
My new number is below.
Saya juga punya dua buku untuk kamu, jadi saya akan membawa buku itu besok.
I also have two books for you, so I will bring them tomorrow.
Sampai jumpa!
See you!

questions.q: Kapan Maya mau menonton film?
questions.en: When does Maya want to watch a film?

questions.q: Di mana mereka bisa bertemu?
questions.en: Where can they meet?

questions.q: Film itu mulai pukul tiga.
questions.en: The film starts at three o'clock.

questions.q: Kalau Rina tidak bisa datang, dia harus menelepon Maya.
questions.en: If Rina can't come, she should call Maya.

passages.title: Kamar saya
sentences: Kamar saya tidak besar, tetapi saya sangat suka kamar ini.
My room is not big, but I really like this room.
Di dalam kamar ada sebuah tempat tidur, sebuah meja, dan dua kursi.
In the room there is a bed, a table and two chairs.
Meja saya dekat jendela, jadi saya bisa melihat pohon di luar.
My table is near the window, so I can see a tree outside.
Di atas meja ada beberapa buku dan sebuah telepon tua.
On the table there are some books and an old telephone.
Warna kamar saya biru, dan pintunya putih.
The colour of my room is blue, and its door is white.
Di dekat pintu ada foto keluarga saya.
Near the door there is a photo of my family.
Setiap pagi saya membuka jendela.
Every morning I open the window.
Saya suka duduk di sini dan membaca buku pada sore hari.
I like sitting here and reading a book in the afternoon.

questions.q: Apa yang ada di dalam kamar?
questions.en: What is in the room?
options: Dua tempat tidur dan satu meja

questions.q: Dari meja, dia bisa melihat pohon.
questions.en: From the table he can see a tree.

questions.q: Apa warna kamar itu?
questions.en: What colour is the room?

questions.q: Foto di dekat pintu adalah foto teman-temannya.
questions.en: The photo near the door is a photo of his friends.

questions.q: Dia menutup jendela setiap pagi.
questions.en: He closes the window every morning.

passages.title: Toko tutup
sentences: Untuk semua orang yang sering datang ke toko kami.
To everyone who often comes to our shop.
Toko kami tutup pada hari Senin dan Selasa minggu depan.
Our shop is closed on Monday and Tuesday next week.
Kami sedang membuat toko ini lebih besar dan lebih bagus.
We are making this shop bigger and nicer.
Pada hari Rabu toko buka lagi pukul delapan pagi.
On Wednesday the shop opens again at eight in the morning.
Hari itu semua roti murah, dan setiap orang mendapat satu kopi atau teh.
That day all the bread is cheap, and everyone gets one coffee or tea.
Anak-anak juga mendapat susu cokelat.
Children also get chocolate milk.
Kalau Anda punya pertanyaan, silakan menelepon kami atau mengirim surat.
If you have a question, please phone us or send a letter.
Maaf karena toko tutup, dan terima kasih banyak.
Sorry that the shop is closed, and thank you very much.

questions.q: Kapan toko itu tutup?
questions.en: When is the shop closed?

questions.q: Toko itu buka lagi pada hari Kamis.
questions.en: The shop opens again on Thursday.

questions.q: Apa yang didapat setiap orang pada hari Rabu?
questions.en: What does everyone get on Wednesday?

questions.q: Orang yang punya pertanyaan bisa menelepon toko.
questions.en: People who have a question can phone the shop.

passages.title: Kucing saya
sentences: Saya punya seekor kucing kecil, dan namanya Momo.
I have a small cat, and his name is Momo.
Momo putih dan hitam, dan matanya hijau.
Momo is white and black, and his eyes are green.
Dia datang ke rumah kami tahun lalu.
He came to our house last year.
Momo suka tidur di atas kursi dekat jendela.
Momo likes sleeping on the chair near the window.
Setiap pagi dan malam saya memberinya ikan.
Every morning and evening I give him fish.
Dia tidak suka air, jadi dia tidak pernah mandi.
He doesn't like water, so he never takes a bath.
Momo sering keluar rumah dan bermain dengan kucing lain.
Momo often goes out of the house and plays with other cats.
Kalau saya pulang dari sekolah, Momo selalu menunggu saya di depan pintu.
When I come home from school, Momo always waits for me in front of the door.

questions.q: Apa warna mata Momo?
questions.en: What colour are Momo's eyes?

questions.q: Momo suka tidur di dekat jendela.
questions.en: Momo likes sleeping near the window.

questions.q: Apa yang dimakan Momo?
questions.en: What does Momo eat?

questions.q: Momo suka bermain di dalam air.
questions.en: Momo likes playing in the water.

questions.q: Momo menunggu di depan pintu ketika anak itu pulang.
questions.en: Momo waits in front of the door when the child comes home.

passages.title: Hari Minggu di gunung
sentences: Hari Minggu lalu keluarga Rudi pergi ke gunung.
Last Sunday Rudi's family went to the mountains.
Mereka pergi pada pagi hari naik mobil ayah.
They left in the morning in Dad's car.
Jalannya panjang, jadi mereka tiba di sana pukul sepuluh.
The road was long, so they arrived there at ten.
Udara di gunung dingin dan bersih.
The air in the mountains was cold and clean.
Rudi dan adiknya berjalan di antara pohon-pohon tinggi.
Rudi and his younger sibling walked among the tall trees.
Ibu membawa nasi, telur, dan teh panas, lalu mereka makan di bawah pohon.
Mum brought rice, eggs and hot tea, and they ate under a tree.
Sore harinya hujan mulai turun, jadi mereka cepat pulang.
In the afternoon it started to rain, so they went home quickly.
Rudi lelah tetapi sangat senang.
Rudi was tired but very happy.

questions.q: Bagaimana keluarga Rudi pergi ke gunung?
questions.en: How did Rudi's family go to the mountains?

questions.q: Udara di gunung panas.
questions.en: The air in the mountains was hot.

questions.q: Apa yang Ibu bawa?
questions.en: What did Mum bring?

questions.q: Mereka pulang karena hujan.
questions.en: They went home because of the rain.

passages.title: Di sekolah
sentences: Dewi murid kelas tiga di sebuah sekolah di Yogyakarta.
Dewi is a third-grade pupil at a school in Yogyakarta.
Setiap pagi dia berjalan ke sekolah dengan temannya, Tini.
Every morning she walks to school with her friend Tini.
Sekolah mulai pukul tujuh.
School starts at seven.
Dewi paling suka Ibu Ani, guru bahasa Indonesia.
Dewi likes Mrs Ani, the Indonesian teacher, best.
Ibu Ani sangat baik dan ceritanya selalu menarik.
Mrs Ani is very kind and her stories are always interesting.
Dewi tidak suka matematika karena menurut dia pelajaran itu sulit.
Dewi doesn't like maths because she thinks that subject is hard.
Pada pukul sepuluh, semua murid keluar kelas dan makan di luar.
At ten o'clock all the pupils leave the classroom and eat outside.
Dewi dan Tini sering bermain bola bersama teman-teman lain.
Dewi and Tini often play ball with other friends.
Sekolah selesai pukul satu siang.
School finishes at one in the afternoon.

questions.q: Bagaimana Dewi pergi ke sekolah?
questions.en: How does Dewi go to school?

questions.q: Ibu Ani mengajar bahasa Inggris.
questions.en: Mrs Ani teaches English.

questions.q: Mengapa Dewi tidak suka matematika?
questions.en: Why doesn't Dewi like maths?

questions.q: Murid-murid makan di dalam kelas.
questions.en: The pupils eat inside the classroom.

questions.q: Sekolah Dewi selesai pada siang hari.
questions.en: Dewi's school finishes in the afternoon.

passages.title: Cara membuat susu cokelat panas
sentences: Minuman ini mudah dibuat dan enak sekali pada malam yang dingin.
This drink is easy to make and very good on a cold night.
Untuk dua orang, Anda perlu susu, sedikit cokelat, dan gula.
For two people you need milk, a little chocolate and sugar.
Pertama, panaskan susu di atas api kecil.
First, heat the milk over a low flame.
Jangan biarkan susu terlalu panas.
Don't let the milk get too hot.
Kemudian, tambahkan cokelat dan gula.
Then add the chocolate and sugar.
Tunggu sebentar sampai cokelat tercampur dengan susu.
Wait a moment until the chocolate is mixed into the milk.
Kalau Anda suka minuman yang tidak terlalu berat, tambahkan sedikit air.
If you like a drink that isn't too heavy, add a little water.
Minum susu cokelat ini ketika masih panas, dengan roti atau buah.
Drink this hot chocolate while it is still hot, with bread or fruit.
Anak-anak pasti suka!
Children will certainly like it!

questions.q: Apa yang Anda panaskan pertama?
questions.en: What do you heat first?

questions.q: Susu harus sangat panas.
questions.en: The milk must be very hot.

questions.q: Apa yang Anda tambahkan ke dalam susu?
questions.en: What do you add to the milk?

questions.q: Anda bisa minum susu cokelat dengan roti.
questions.en: You can drink the hot chocolate with bread.

passages.title: Surat untuk Pak Hasan
sentences: Selamat pagi, Pak Hasan.
Good morning, Mr Hasan.
Saya Rina, ibu dari Tono di kelas dua.
I am Rina, the mother of Tono in class two.
Maaf, hari ini Tono tidak bisa datang ke sekolah karena dia sakit.
Sorry, today Tono can't come to school because he is ill.
Tadi malam kepalanya sakit dan dia tidak bisa tidur.
Last night he had a headache and couldn't sleep.
Pagi ini kami pergi ke dokter, dan dokter memberi dia obat.
This morning we went to the doctor, and the doctor gave him medicine.
Menurut dokter, Tono harus beristirahat di rumah selama dua hari.
According to the doctor, Tono must rest at home for two days.
Mungkin dia bisa kembali ke sekolah pada hari Kamis.
Maybe he can come back to school on Thursday.
Apakah ada tugas untuk Tono?
Is there any homework for Tono?
Terima kasih, Pak.
Thank you, sir.

questions.q: Siapa yang menulis surat ini?
questions.en: Who wrote this letter?

questions.q: Tono tidak masuk sekolah hari ini karena sakit.
questions.en: Tono is absent from school today because he is ill.

questions.q: Apa yang terjadi tadi malam?
questions.en: What happened last night?

questions.q: Dokter tidak memberi Tono obat.
questions.en: The doctor didn't give Tono medicine.

questions.q: Tono akan kembali ke sekolah besok.
questions.en: Tono will go back to school tomorrow.

passages.title: Pesta di rumah Lina
sentences: Hari Sabtu kemarin ada pesta kecil di rumah Lina.
Last Saturday there was a small party at Lina's house.
Umur Lina sekarang dua puluh tahun.
Lina is now twenty years old.
Dia mengundang sepuluh teman dari sekolah dan dari kantor.
She invited ten friends from school and from the office.
Ibu Lina memasak banyak makanan: nasi kuning, ayam, dan ikan.
Lina's mother cooked a lot of food: yellow rice, chicken and fish.
Teman-temannya membawa bunga, buku, dan sebuah tas merah.
Her friends brought flowers, books and a red bag.
Lina sangat suka tas itu.
Lina really liked that bag.
Setelah makan, mereka mendengarkan musik dan menyanyikan lagu bersama.
After eating, they listened to music and sang songs together.
Pesta itu selesai pukul sepuluh malam.
The party ended at ten at night.
Semua orang pulang dengan senang.
Everyone went home happy.

questions.q: Berapa umur Lina sekarang?
questions.en: How old is Lina now?

questions.q: Apa yang dimasak Ibu Lina?
questions.en: What did Lina's mother cook?

questions.q: Lina tidak suka tas merah itu.
questions.en: Lina didn't like the red bag.

questions.q: Setelah makan, mereka menyanyi bersama.
questions.en: After eating, they sang together.

passages.title: Telepon dari Ibu
sentences: "Halo, Joko? Ini Ibu."
"Hello, Joko? It's Mum."
"Halo, Bu! Apa kabar?"
"Hello, Mum! How are you?"
"Baik. Kamu sudah makan?"
"Fine. Have you eaten yet?"
"Belum, Bu. Saya masih di kantor, dan pekerjaan saya belum selesai."
"Not yet, Mum. I'm still at the office, and my work isn't finished."
"Jangan bekerja terlalu lama, ya. Kamu kapan pulang ke rumah?"
"Don't work too long, all right? When are you coming home?"
"Mungkin bulan depan, Bu. Saya ingin naik kereta dari Jakarta."
"Maybe next month, Mum. I want to take the train from Jakarta."
"Bagus. Ayah dan adikmu rindu padamu."
"Good. Your father and your younger sibling miss you."
"Nanti Ibu memasak ikan yang kamu suka, ya. Kamu juga harus tidur yang cukup."
"I'll cook the fish you like, all right. And you must get enough sleep."
"Baik, Bu. Nanti malam saya telepon lagi."
"All right, Mum. I'll call again later tonight."

questions.q: Joko sudah makan.
questions.en: Joko has already eaten.

questions.q: Di mana Joko sekarang?
questions.en: Where is Joko now?

questions.q: Kapan Joko mungkin pulang?
questions.en: When might Joko go home?

questions.q: Joko ingin pulang naik kereta.
questions.en: Joko wants to go home by train.

questions.q: Joko akan menelepon ibunya lagi nanti malam.
questions.en: Joko will call his mother again later tonight.

passages.title: Musim hujan
sentences: Di Indonesia hanya ada dua musim: musim hujan dan musim kering.
In Indonesia there are only two seasons: the rainy season and the dry season.
Musim hujan biasanya mulai pada bulan Oktober atau November.
The rainy season usually starts in October or November.
Pada bulan-bulan itu, hujan turun hampir setiap hari, sering pada sore hari.
In those months it rains almost every day, often in the afternoon.
Jalan-jalan di kota penuh air, dan mobil berjalan lambat.
The streets in the city are full of water, and cars move slowly.
Banyak orang tidak mau keluar rumah pada sore hari.
Many people don't want to leave the house in the afternoon.
Anak-anak suka bermain di bawah hujan, tetapi orang tua mereka tidak senang.
Children like playing in the rain, but their parents are not happy.
Musim hujan selesai sekitar bulan April.
The rainy season ends around April.
Setelah itu, cuaca panas lagi.
After that, the weather is hot again.

questions.q: Biasanya musim hujan mulai pada bulan Juli.
questions.en: The rainy season usually starts in July.

questions.q: Kapan hujan sering turun?
questions.en: When does it often rain?

questions.q: Bagaimana jalan-jalan di kota pada musim hujan?
questions.en: What are the city streets like in the rainy season?

questions.q: Anak-anak senang bermain ketika hujan turun.
questions.en: Children enjoy playing when it rains.

passages.title: Rumah baru kami
sentences: Bulan lalu keluarga kami pindah ke rumah baru.
Last month our family moved to a new house.
Rumah lama kami kecil dan jauh dari kota.
Our old house was small and far from town.
Rumah baru ini lebih besar dan dekat dengan sekolah saya.
This new house is bigger and close to my school.
Ada empat kamar tidur, jadi sekarang saya punya kamar sendiri.
There are four bedrooms, so now I have my own room.
Di belakang rumah ada pohon besar dan banyak bunga.
Behind the house there is a big tree and a lot of flowers.
Ayah senang karena kantornya juga tidak jauh.
Dad is happy because his office is not far either.
Ibu suka pasar di dekat rumah karena harga di sana murah.
Mum likes the market near the house because prices there are cheap.
Tetapi adik saya masih ingat teman-temannya di rumah lama, dan dia sedikit sedih.
But my younger sibling still remembers their friends at the old house, and they are a little sad.

questions.q: Bagaimana rumah lama mereka?
questions.en: What was their old house like?

questions.q: Rumah baru itu jauh dari sekolah.
questions.en: The new house is far from the school.

questions.q: Sekarang anak itu tidur di kamarnya sendiri.
questions.en: Now the child sleeps in their own room.

questions.q: Mengapa Ibu suka pasar di dekat rumah?
questions.en: Why does Mum like the market near the house?

questions.q: Adiknya sedih karena rindu teman-temannya.
questions.en: The younger sibling is sad because they miss their friends.

passages.title: Teman baru dari Jepang
sentences: Halo Yuki, apa kabar?
Hello Yuki, how are you?
Nama saya Ayu, dan saya tinggal di Bali.
My name is Ayu, and I live in Bali.
Umur saya lima belas tahun, dan saya murid kelas sepuluh.
I am fifteen years old, and I am a pupil in year ten.
Saya suka membaca, menyanyi, dan pergi ke laut dengan adik saya.
I like reading, singing and going to the sea with my younger sibling.
Saya belajar bahasa Jepang di sekolah, tetapi bahasa itu sulit untuk saya.
I study Japanese at school, but that language is hard for me.
Apakah kamu juga belajar bahasa Indonesia?
Do you also study Indonesian?
Saya ingin tahu tentang kotamu, sekolahmu, dan keluargamu.
I want to know about your city, your school and your family.
Tolong kirim foto kotamu, ya.
Please send a photo of your city.
Saya tunggu suratmu!
I'm waiting for your letter!

questions.q: Di mana Ayu tinggal?
questions.en: Where does Ayu live?

questions.q: Ayu suka pergi ke laut dengan adiknya.
questions.en: Ayu likes going to the sea with her younger sibling.

questions.q: Menurut Ayu, bahasa Jepang mudah.
questions.en: According to Ayu, Japanese is easy.

questions.q: Apa yang Ayu minta dari Yuki?
questions.en: What does Ayu ask Yuki for?

passages.title: Rumah makan Pak Agus
sentences: Kemarin saya makan siang di rumah makan Pak Agus di Jalan Merdeka.
Yesterday I had lunch at Mr Agus's restaurant on Merdeka Street.
Tempatnya kecil tetapi bersih, dan orang-orangnya baik.
The place is small but clean, and the people are kind.
Saya makan nasi dengan ayam dan sayur, lalu minum teh dingin.
I ate rice with chicken and vegetables, then drank iced tea.
Ayamnya enak sekali, tetapi sayurnya sedikit dingin.
The chicken was really delicious, but the vegetables were a little cold.
Harganya murah: saya hanya membayar tiga puluh ribu.
The price was cheap: I only paid thirty thousand.
Rumah makan ini buka dari pukul sepuluh pagi sampai pukul sembilan malam.
This restaurant is open from ten in the morning until nine at night.
Pada jam makan siang, banyak orang dari kantor datang ke sana, jadi Anda harus menunggu.
At lunchtime many people from the offices come there, so you have to wait.
Saya pasti akan kembali lagi.
I will certainly come back again.

questions.q: Apa yang dia minum?
questions.en: What did he drink?

questions.q: Semua makanan di sana panas dan enak.
questions.en: All the food there was hot and delicious.

questions.q: Makanan di rumah makan itu tidak mahal.
questions.en: The food at that restaurant is not expensive.

questions.q: Mengapa orang harus menunggu pada jam makan siang?
questions.en: Why do people have to wait at lunchtime?

passages.title: Belajar bahasa Indonesia
sentences: Nama saya Tom, dan saya berasal dari Australia.
My name is Tom, and I come from Australia.
Sekarang saya tinggal di Jakarta karena pekerjaan saya.
Now I live in Jakarta because of my job.
Setiap Selasa dan Kamis saya belajar bahasa Indonesia dengan seorang guru.
Every Tuesday and Thursday I study Indonesian with a teacher.
Kelasnya dua jam, dari pukul enam sampai pukul delapan malam.
The class is two hours long, from six to eight in the evening.
Menurut saya, bahasa Indonesia tidak terlalu sulit.
In my opinion, Indonesian is not too difficult.
Tetapi saya sering lupa kata-kata baru.
But I often forget new words.
Jadi saya menulis kata-kata itu di buku kecil dan membacanya di bus.
So I write those words in a small book and read them on the bus.
Saya juga berbicara dengan orang di pasar dan di kantor.
I also talk with people at the market and at the office.
Mereka selalu senang dan membantu saya.
They are always happy and help me.

passages.title: Di mana kunci saya?
sentences: Pagi ini saya bangun terlambat.
This morning I woke up late.
Saya cepat mandi, memakai baju, dan minum air.
I quickly showered, got dressed and drank some water.
Tetapi ketika saya mau keluar, saya tidak bisa menemukan kunci rumah.
But when I wanted to go out, I couldn't find the house key.
Saya mencari kunci itu di atas meja, di dalam tas, dan di bawah tempat tidur.
I looked for the key on the table, in my bag and under the bed.
Kunci itu tidak ada di mana-mana!
The key wasn't anywhere!
Saya menelepon istri saya di kantor.
I phoned my wife at the office.
"Coba lihat di pintu," katanya.
"Try looking in the door," she said.
Benar, kunci itu masih di pintu dari tadi malam.
Right, the key was still in the door from last night.
Saya tertawa, lalu pergi ke kantor naik sepeda.
I laughed, then went to the office by bicycle.

questions.en: This morning he got up late.

questions.en: Where was the key?

passages.title: Di kereta
sentences: Setiap Jumat sore, Dimas naik kereta dari Jakarta ke Bogor.
Every Friday afternoon Dimas takes the train from Jakarta to Bogor.
Orang tuanya tinggal di Bogor, dan dia pulang untuk hari Sabtu dan Minggu.
His parents live in Bogor, and he goes home for Saturday and Sunday.
Kereta itu selalu penuh, jadi Dimas sering berdiri.
The train is always full, so Dimas often stands.
Kadang dia bisa duduk dekat jendela dan melihat pohon-pohon hijau.
Sometimes he can sit near the window and look at the green trees.
Di kereta, dia mendengarkan musik atau membaca berita di teleponnya.
On the train he listens to music or reads the news on his phone.
Perjalanan itu lebih dari satu jam.
The trip takes more than an hour.
Ibunya selalu menunggu dia di rumah dengan makan malam.
His mother always waits for him at home with dinner.
Dimas senang karena bisa bertemu keluarganya setiap minggu.
Dimas is happy because he can see his family every week.

questions.q: Ke mana Dimas pergi setiap Jumat?
questions.en: Where does Dimas go every Friday?

questions.q: Dimas selalu bisa duduk di kereta.
questions.en: Dimas can always sit on the train.

questions.q: Apa yang dia lakukan di kereta?
questions.en: What does he do on the train?

questions.q: Ibu Dimas menunggu dia dengan makan malam.
questions.en: Dimas's mother waits for him with dinner.

passages.title: Liburan di Lombok
sentences: Bulan Juli lalu, saya dan dua teman saya berlibur ke Lombok selama satu minggu.
Last July, two friends and I went on holiday to Lombok for a week.
Kami berangkat dari Jakarta naik pesawat dan tiba di sana pada siang hari.
We left Jakarta by plane and arrived there at midday.
Hotel kami kecil, tetapi kamarnya bersih dan dekat dengan pantai.
Our hotel was small, but the rooms were clean and close to the beach.
Setiap pagi kami berenang di laut sebelum sarapan.
Every morning we swam in the sea before breakfast.
Air lautnya sangat bersih, jadi kami bisa melihat banyak ikan berwarna.
The sea water was very clean, so we could see lots of coloured fish.
Pada hari ketiga, kami naik perahu kecil ke sebuah pulau.
On the third day we took a small boat to an island.
Sayangnya, hujan turun sepanjang sore, dan kami harus menunggu di sebuah rumah makan.
Unfortunately it rained all afternoon, and we had to wait in a restaurant.
Di sana kami makan ikan bakar yang enak sekali.
There we ate delicious grilled fish.
Pada hari terakhir, kami membeli kain dan kopi sebagai hadiah untuk keluarga.
On the last day we bought cloth and coffee as gifts for our families.
Liburan itu tidak mahal, dan kami ingin kembali tahun depan.
The holiday wasn't expensive, and we want to go back next year.

questions.en: How long were they on holiday in Lombok?

questions.q: Apa yang mereka beli untuk keluarga?
questions.en: What did they buy for their families?

passages.title: Pekerjaan baru Rizky
sentences: Rizky baru mulai bekerja di sebuah perusahaan komputer di Surabaya.
Rizky has just started working at a computer company in Surabaya.
Kantornya ada di lantai lima sebuah gedung tinggi di pusat kota.
His office is on the fifth floor of a tall building in the city centre.
Pada hari pertama, bosnya mengajak dia bertemu dengan semua orang di bagiannya.
On the first day his boss took him to meet everyone in his department.
Teman-teman kantornya baik dan selalu mau membantu kalau dia punya pertanyaan.
His office colleagues are kind and always willing to help when he has questions.
Tugas Rizky adalah memperbaiki program dan menjawab pertanyaan dari orang-orang yang memakai program perusahaan itu.
Rizky's task is to fix programs and answer questions from people who use the company's programs.
Pekerjaannya menarik, tetapi kadang-kadang sulit, apalagi kalau programnya sudah tua.
His work is interesting, but sometimes difficult, especially when a program is old.
Dia mulai bekerja pukul delapan dan pulang pukul lima.
He starts work at eight and goes home at five.
Masalahnya, jalan ke kantor selalu penuh mobil dan motor pada pagi hari.
The problem is that the road to the office is always full of cars and motorbikes in the morning.
Karena itu, Rizky sekarang berangkat lebih awal dan naik kereta.
Because of that, Rizky now leaves earlier and takes the train.
Dia senang dengan pekerjaan barunya dan ingin belajar banyak hal.
He is happy with his new job and wants to learn many things.

questions.en: Where is Rizky's office?

questions.q: Teman-teman di kantor Rizky mau membantunya.
questions.en: Rizky's colleagues at the office are willing to help him.

questions.en: What is Rizky's task?

questions.q: Pada pagi hari, ada banyak kendaraan di jalan ke kantornya.
questions.en: In the morning there are many vehicles on the road to his office.

questions.q: Bagaimana Rizky pergi ke kantor sekarang?
questions.en: How does Rizky go to the office now?

passages.title: Ke dokter
sentences: Sudah tiga hari Siti sakit kepala dan badannya panas.
Siti has had a headache and a fever for three days.
Dia tidak bisa pergi ke kantor, jadi dia menelepon bosnya pada pagi hari.
She couldn't go to the office, so she phoned her boss in the morning.
Kemudian dia pergi ke dokter di dekat rumahnya.
Then she went to the doctor near her house.
Di ruang tunggu ada banyak pasien, dan Siti harus menunggu hampir satu jam.
There were many patients in the waiting room, and Siti had to wait almost an hour.
Dokter memeriksa mulut dan matanya, lalu bertanya apakah dia merokok.
The doctor checked her mouth and eyes, then asked whether she smoked.
"Tidak, Dok, saya tidak pernah merokok," jawab Siti.
"No, doctor, I have never smoked," Siti answered.
Menurut dokter, Siti kena flu biasa, dan penyakitnya tidak parah.
According to the doctor, Siti had an ordinary flu, and the illness was not serious.
Dia memberi Siti obat dan meminta dia beristirahat di rumah selama tiga hari.
The doctor gave Siti medicine and asked her to rest at home for three days.
Dia juga harus minum banyak air dan makan buah.
She also had to drink lots of water and eat fruit.
Setelah dua hari, Siti sudah merasa lebih baik, tetapi dia tetap tinggal di rumah sampai obatnya habis.
After two days Siti already felt better, but she still stayed at home until her medicine ran out.

questions.q: Siti pergi ke kantor sebelum dia ke dokter.
questions.en: Siti went to the office before she went to the doctor.

questions.q: Berapa lama Siti menunggu?
questions.en: How long did Siti wait?

questions.en: What did the doctor ask?

questions.en: According to the doctor, Siti's illness is not dangerous.

questions.q: Menurut dokter, Siti perlu tiga hari untuk beristirahat.
questions.en: According to the doctor, Siti needs three days to rest.

passages.title: Apartemen untuk disewakan
sentences: Dicari: orang yang ingin menyewa apartemen di Jalan Sudirman, Jakarta Selatan.
Wanted: someone who wants to rent a flat on Sudirman Street, South Jakarta.
Apartemen ini ada di lantai empat dan punya dua kamar tidur.
This flat is on the fourth floor and has two bedrooms.
Dapurnya kecil tetapi baru, dan ada kulkas serta mesin cuci.
The kitchen is small but new, and there is a fridge and a washing machine.
Dari jendela ruang tamu, Anda bisa melihat taman yang luas.
From the living-room window you can see a large park.
Stasiun kereta hanya lima menit dengan berjalan kaki, dan ada pasar di sebelah gedung.
The train station is only five minutes' walk, and there is a market next to the building.
Harga sewanya lima juta per bulan, termasuk listrik dan air.
The rent is five million a month, including electricity and water.
Anda tidak boleh merokok di dalam apartemen, dan hewan juga tidak boleh.
You may not smoke inside the flat, and animals are not allowed either.
Apartemen ini cocok untuk pasangan atau dua pelajar.
This flat is suitable for a couple or two students.
Kalau tertarik, silakan menghubungi Ibu Mega setelah pukul lima sore.
If you are interested, please contact Mrs Mega after five in the afternoon.

passages.title: Resep nasi goreng
sentences: Nasi goreng adalah makanan yang sangat populer di Indonesia.
Fried rice is a very popular dish in Indonesia.
Banyak orang memasaknya untuk sarapan dengan nasi dari malam sebelumnya.
Many people cook it for breakfast with rice from the night before.
Untuk dua orang, Anda perlu dua piring nasi, dua telur, sedikit bawang, dan garam.
For two people you need two plates of rice, two eggs, a little onion and salt.
Pertama, potong bawang menjadi kecil-kecil.
First, cut the onion into small pieces.
Panaskan sedikit minyak di atas api, lalu tambahkan bawang.
Heat a little oil over the fire, then add the onion.
Setelah bawangnya berwarna cokelat, tambahkan telur dan campur dengan cepat.
When the onion turns brown, add the eggs and mix quickly.
Kemudian tambahkan nasi dan garam, lalu masak selama lima menit sampai semuanya panas.
Then add the rice and salt, and cook for five minutes until everything is hot.
Kalau suka, Anda bisa menambahkan ayam atau sayur.
If you like, you can add chicken or vegetables.
Nasi goreng paling enak dimakan ketika masih panas, dengan teh manis atau air dingin.
Fried rice is best eaten while it is still hot, with sweet tea or cold water.

questions.q: Banyak orang makan nasi goreng pada pagi hari.
questions.en: Many people eat fried rice in the morning.

questions.q: Apa yang Anda lakukan dengan bawang pertama kali?
questions.en: What do you do with the onion first?

questions.q: Kapan Anda menambahkan telur?
questions.en: When do you add the eggs?

questions.q: Nasi goreng dimasak selama setengah jam.
questions.en: The fried rice is cooked for half an hour.

passages.title: Hari yang buruk

oop.ojek: motorbike taxi: everyday Indonesian transport, no pack word

sentences: Kemarin adalah hari yang sangat buruk untuk Fajar.
Yesterday was a very bad day for Fajar.
Pagi itu, dia tidak mendengar suara jamnya dan bangun terlambat.
That morning he didn't hear his alarm clock and woke up late.
Dia tidak sempat sarapan dan langsung lari ke jalan besar untuk menunggu bus.
He had no time for breakfast and ran straight to the main road to wait for the bus.
Busnya sudah berangkat, jadi dia harus naik ojek.
The bus had already left, so he had to take a motorbike taxi.
Di tengah jalan, hujan turun sangat keras, dan bajunya basah semua.
Halfway there it rained very hard, and his clothes got completely wet.
Dia tiba di kantor dua puluh menit terlambat, dan rapat sudah mulai.
He arrived at the office twenty minutes late, and the meeting had already started.
Siang harinya, dia sadar bahwa dompetnya tertinggal di rumah.
At midday he realised that he had left his wallet at home.
Untungnya, seorang teman mau membayar makan siangnya.
Luckily, a friend was willing to pay for his lunch.
Malamnya, Fajar pulang dengan lelah, makan nasi dengan telur, dan langsung tidur.
In the evening Fajar went home tired, ate rice with an egg, and went straight to bed.
"Besok pasti lebih baik," katanya.
"Tomorrow will surely be better," he said.

passages.title: Taman baru di kota kami
sentences: Minggu lalu, pemerintah kota membuka sebuah taman baru di dekat sungai.
Last week the city government opened a new park near the river.
Dulu tempat itu adalah pabrik tua yang kosong dan kotor.
That place used to be an old, empty and dirty factory.
Sekarang ada banyak pohon, bunga, dan jalan kecil untuk berjalan kaki atau naik sepeda.
Now there are many trees, flowers and small paths for walking or cycling.
Di tengah taman ada sebuah kolam besar dengan ikan berwarna merah dan kuning.
In the middle of the park there is a big pond with red and yellow fish.
Anak-anak bisa bermain di tempat khusus yang aman.
Children can play in a special, safe area.
Taman ini buka setiap hari dari pukul enam pagi sampai pukul sembilan malam, dan masuknya gratis.
The park is open every day from six in the morning until nine at night, and entry is free.
Orang tidak boleh membawa motor ke dalam taman atau membuang sampah di sana.
People may not bring motorbikes into the park or throw rubbish there.
Banyak warga senang dengan taman ini.
Many residents are happy with this park.
"Dulu anak-anak saya bermain di jalan," kata seorang ibu.
"My children used to play in the street," said one mother.
"Sekarang mereka punya tempat yang bersih dan hijau."
"Now they have a clean, green place."

questions.en: What was in that place before?

questions.q: Seorang ibu berkata bahwa anak-anaknya dulu bermain di jalan.
questions.en: One mother said that her children used to play in the street.

passages.title: Pesta kejutan untuk Nenek
sentences: Bulan depan nenek kami berumur tujuh puluh tahun.
Next month our grandmother turns seventy.
Kami ingin membuat pesta kejutan untuk dia di rumah Paman Hendra.
We want to throw a surprise party for her at Uncle Hendra's house.
Ibu akan memasak makanan yang paling Nenek sukai, dan saya akan membuat kue.
Mum will cook the food Grandma likes best, and I will make a cake.
Kakak saya mengundang semua saudara dan tetangga lewat telepon.
My older sibling is inviting all the relatives and neighbours by phone.
Pada hari Sabtu, Paman akan mengajak Nenek jalan-jalan ke pasar.
On Saturday Uncle will take Grandma for a walk to the market.
Sementara itu, kami menyiapkan rumah dengan bunga dan lampu.
Meanwhile, we will prepare the house with flowers and lights.
Ketika Nenek pulang, semua orang akan menyanyi bersama.
When Grandma comes home, everyone will sing together.
Masalahnya, Nenek sangat pintar dan sering tahu rahasia kami.
The problem is that Grandma is very clever and often knows our secrets.
Jadi, jangan beri tahu dia tentang pesta ini, ya!
So don't tell her about this party, all right!
Kami berharap Nenek akan terkejut dan bahagia.
We hope Grandma will be surprised and happy.

questions.en: How old will Grandma be next month?

questions.en: Where is the party?

questions.en: The older sibling invites people by letter.

passages.title: Rencana untuk besok
sentences: Halo semua, ini rencana kita untuk perjalanan besok.
Hello everyone, this is our plan for tomorrow's trip.
Bus berangkat dari depan sekolah tepat pukul tujuh pagi, jadi jangan terlambat.
The bus leaves from in front of the school at seven sharp, so don't be late.
Pertama, kita akan mengunjungi sebuah desa di kaki gunung.
First we will visit a village at the foot of the mountain.
Di sana orang desa akan menjelaskan cara menanam kopi.
There the villagers will explain how to grow coffee.
Kita makan siang bersama di rumah kepala desa sekitar pukul dua belas.
We will have lunch together at the village head's house around twelve.
Setelah itu, kita berjalan ke sebuah danau kecil yang indah.
After that we will walk to a small, beautiful lake.
Kalian boleh berenang, tetapi hanya di tempat yang aman.
You may swim, but only in the safe place.
Kita pulang pukul empat dan tiba di sekolah sekitar pukul enam.
We will leave at four and arrive at school around six.
Jangan lupa membawa topi, air minum, dan baju ganti.
Don't forget to bring a hat, drinking water and a change of clothes.
Kalau ada pertanyaan, hubungi Pak Eko.
If you have questions, contact Mr Eko.

questions.q: Bus berangkat pada pukul delapan.
questions.en: The bus leaves at eight o'clock.

questions.en: What will the villagers explain?

questions.en: Where will they have lunch?

questions.en: They may swim anywhere in the lake.

questions.q: Mereka harus membawa topi.
questions.en: They must bring a hat.

passages.title: Film apa yang kita tonton?
sentences: "Nina, kamu mau menonton film malam ini?" tanya Bayu.
"Nina, do you want to watch a film tonight?" Bayu asked.
"Boleh. Film apa?" jawab Nina.
"Sure. Which film?" Nina answered.
"Ada film baru tentang dua orang yang tersesat di hutan. Katanya sangat menakutkan."
"There's a new film about two people who get lost in a forest. They say it's very scary."
"Saya tidak suka film yang menakutkan. Nanti malam saya tidak bisa tidur, dan besok saya ada ujian."
"I don't like scary films. I won't be able to sleep tonight, and tomorrow I have an exam."
"Bagaimana dengan film lucu tentang keluarga yang pindah ke desa?"
"How about the funny film about a family that moves to a village?"
"Itu lebih baik. Jam berapa filmnya mulai?"
"That's better. What time does the film start?"
"Pukul tujuh dan pukul sembilan. Kita pilih yang pukul tujuh saja, ya, karena besok saya harus bangun pagi," jawab Bayu.
"At seven and at nine. Let's just choose the seven o'clock one, because I have to get up early tomorrow," Bayu answered.
"Oke. Saya beli tiketnya lewat internet sekarang," kata Nina.
"OK. I'll buy the tickets on the internet now," said Nina.
"Terima kasih! Nanti saya yang membayar makan malam."
"Thanks! I'll pay for dinner later."

passages.title: Pertandingan hari Sabtu
sentences: Setiap Sabtu sore, Andi bermain sepak bola dengan teman-teman dari desanya.
Every Saturday afternoon Andi plays football with friends from his village.
Sabtu lalu, tim mereka bermain melawan tim dari desa sebelah.
Last Saturday their team played against a team from the next village.
Pertandingan itu mulai pukul empat di sebuah lapangan dekat sekolah.
The match started at four on a field near the school.
Banyak orang datang untuk menonton, termasuk orang tua Andi.
Many people came to watch, including Andi's parents.
Pada awalnya, tim desa sebelah bermain lebih cepat, dan mereka memasukkan bola pertama.
At first the team from the next village played faster, and they scored the first goal.
Andi dan teman-temannya tidak menyerah dan terus berusaha.
Andi and his friends didn't give up and kept trying.
Sepuluh menit sebelum pertandingan selesai, Andi menendang bola dari jauh, dan bola itu masuk!
Ten minutes before the match ended, Andi kicked the ball from far away, and it went in!
Akhirnya tidak ada tim yang menang.
In the end neither team won.
Setelah pertandingan, kedua tim minum es teh bersama di bawah pohon besar.
After the match both teams drank iced tea together under a big tree.
Andi sangat lelah, tetapi dia bangga dengan timnya.
Andi was very tired, but he was proud of his team.
