passages.title: Kehidupan di universitas
sentences: Rina adalah mahasiswa tahun pertama di sebuah universitas di Malang.
Rina is a first-year student at a university in Malang.
Dia belajar ekonomi, dan dia tinggal di sebuah kamar kecil dekat kampus bersama dua mahasiswa lain.
She studies economics, and she lives in a small room near the campus with two other students.
Setiap hari dia punya dua atau tiga kuliah.
Every day she has two or three lectures.
Kuliah pertama biasanya mulai pukul tujuh pagi, jadi dia harus bangun pukul lima.
The first lecture usually starts at seven in the morning, so she has to get up at five.
Pada sore hari, Rina sering belajar di perpustakaan karena tempatnya tenang dan nyaman.
In the afternoon Rina often studies in the library because it is quiet and comfortable.
Dia juga ikut kelompok musik dan bermain gitar dua kali seminggu.
She also joined a music group and plays guitar twice a week.
Kadang-kadang dia rindu keluarganya di Medan, tetapi dia menelepon mereka setiap malam.
Sometimes she misses her family in Medan, but she calls them every evening.
Ujian pertamanya bulan depan.
Her first exam is next month.
Dia sedikit takut, tetapi teman-temannya membantu dia belajar.
She is a little afraid, but her friends help her study.

questions.q: Apa yang Rina pelajari?
questions.en: What does Rina study?

questions.q: Rina tinggal sendirian di rumah yang besar.
questions.en: Rina lives alone in a big house.

questions.q: Mengapa Rina suka belajar di perpustakaan?
questions.en: Why does Rina like studying in the library?

questions.q: Rina bermain gitar dengan sebuah kelompok musik.
questions.en: Rina plays guitar with a music group.

questions.q: Ujian pertama Rina minggu ini.
questions.en: Rina's first exam is this week.

passages.title: Informasi untuk penumpang
sentences: Perhatian, perhatian.
Attention, please.
Kereta api Argo dari Jakarta ke Yogyakarta yang seharusnya berangkat pukul sepuluh pagi terlambat satu jam.
The Argo train from Jakarta to Yogyakarta, which was due to leave at ten in the morning, is one hour late.
Ada masalah dengan mesin kereta, dan petugas sedang memperbaikinya.
There is a problem with the train's engine, and staff are repairing it.
Kereta itu baru akan berangkat pukul sebelas dari jalur tiga, bukan dari jalur satu.
The train will only leave at eleven, from platform three, not from platform one.
Penumpang yang sudah punya tiket tidak perlu membeli tiket baru.
Passengers who already have a ticket do not need to buy a new one.
Sambil menunggu, Anda bisa duduk di ruang tunggu di lantai dua.
While waiting, you can sit in the waiting room on the second floor.
Di sana ada air minum gratis dan beberapa toko kecil.
There is free drinking water and some small shops there.
Kalau Anda ingin membatalkan perjalanan, silakan datang ke kantor tiket, dan uang Anda akan dikembalikan.
If you want to cancel your trip, please come to the ticket office, and your money will be returned.
Kami minta maaf atas keadaan ini.
We apologise for this situation.
Terima kasih.
Thank you.

questions.q: Mengapa kereta itu terlambat?
questions.en: Why is the train late?

questions.q: Pukul berapa kereta itu akan berangkat sekarang?
questions.en: What time will the train leave now?

questions.q: Kereta itu akan berangkat dari jalur satu.
questions.en: The train will leave from platform one.

questions.q: Tiket yang sudah dibeli masih bisa dipakai.
questions.en: Tickets already bought can still be used.

questions.q: Air minum di ruang tunggu tidak perlu dibayar.
questions.en: You don't have to pay for the drinking water in the waiting room.

passages.title: Pasar pagi hari Minggu
sentences: Setiap hari Minggu, ada pasar pagi di lapangan dekat rumah saya.
Every Sunday there is a morning market on the field near my house.
Pasar itu mulai pukul lima pagi dan selesai sekitar pukul sepuluh.
The market starts at five in the morning and finishes around ten.
Saya suka datang lebih awal karena sayur dan buahnya masih segar dan udaranya belum panas.
I like coming early because the vegetables and fruit are still fresh and the air is not yet hot.
Di pasar ini orang menjual hampir semua barang: ikan, daging, kue, baju, bahkan mainan.
At this market people sell almost everything: fish, meat, cakes, clothes, even toys.
Harga di sini biasanya lebih murah daripada di toko besar.
Prices here are usually cheaper than in big shops.
Minggu lalu saya membeli beberapa apel dan sepatu olahraga.
Last week I bought some apples and sports shoes.
Sepatu itu bagus sekali dan harganya hanya seratus ribu.
The shoes are very nice and they only cost a hundred thousand.
Setelah itu, saya selalu sarapan nasi kuning di sana.
After that I always have yellow rice for breakfast there.
Pasar pagi itu selalu penuh orang, tetapi saya senang karena bisa bertemu tetangga.
The morning market is always full of people, but I like it because I can meet my neighbours.

questions.q: Pasar itu buka pada hari Sabtu.
questions.en: The market is open on Saturday.

questions.q: Mengapa dia suka datang pagi?
questions.en: Why does she like coming early?
options: Harganya lebih murah pada pagi hari

questions.q: Apa yang dia beli minggu lalu?
questions.en: What did she buy last week?

questions.q: Sepatu itu mahal.
questions.en: The shoes were expensive.

questions.q: Di pasar pagi, dia bisa bertemu tetangganya.
questions.en: At the morning market she can meet her neighbours.

passages.title: Lingkungan saya
sentences: Saya tinggal di sebuah kampung kecil di kota Semarang.
I live in a small neighbourhood in the city of Semarang.
Jalan-jalan di sini sempit, jadi mobil jarang lewat, tetapi banyak motor.
The streets here are narrow, so cars rarely pass, but there are many motorbikes.
Di ujung jalan saya ada sebuah masjid, sebuah sekolah dasar, dan toko kecil milik Pak Umar.
At the end of my street there is a mosque, a primary school and a small shop owned by Mr Umar.
Toko itu menjual hampir semua barang, dari gula sampai obat.
That shop sells almost everything, from sugar to medicine.
Tetangga-tetangga saya sangat baik.
My neighbours are very kind.
Kalau ada orang yang sakit, mereka datang membawa makanan.
If someone is ill, they come and bring food.
Setiap bulan, semua warga membersihkan jalan dan taman bersama-sama.
Every month all the residents clean the streets and the park together.
Kekurangannya, kampung ini agak jauh dari pusat kota, dan bus hanya lewat setiap setengah jam.
The downside is that the neighbourhood is rather far from the city centre, and buses only come every half hour.
Tetapi saya tidak mau pindah, karena di sini saya merasa seperti di rumah sendiri.
But I don't want to move, because here I feel at home.

questions.q: Di jalan-jalan kampung itu, ada lebih banyak motor daripada mobil.
questions.en: On the neighbourhood's streets there are more motorbikes than cars.

questions.q: Apa yang ada di ujung jalan?
questions.en: What is at the end of the street?

questions.q: Apa yang dilakukan tetangga kalau ada orang sakit?
questions.en: What do the neighbours do when someone is ill?

questions.q: Bus lewat kampung itu setiap lima menit.
questions.en: The bus passes through the neighbourhood every five minutes.

questions.q: Dia tidak mau pindah dari kampungnya.
questions.en: She doesn't want to move out of her neighbourhood.

passages.title: Jatuh dari sepeda
sentences: Hari Rabu lalu, Eko jatuh dari sepedanya ketika dia pulang dari sekolah.
Last Wednesday Eko fell off his bicycle when he was coming home from school.
Waktu itu hujan baru berhenti, dan jalannya masih basah.
The rain had just stopped, and the road was still wet.
Seekor kucing lari ke tengah jalan, dan Eko tidak bisa berhenti.
A cat ran into the middle of the road, and Eko couldn't stop.
Dia jatuh, dan kaki kirinya sakit sekali.
He fell, and his left leg hurt a lot.
Seorang ibu yang lewat membantu dia berdiri dan menelepon ayahnya.
A woman who was passing helped him stand up and phoned his father.
Ayah Eko datang dengan mobil dan membawa dia ke rumah sakit.
Eko's father came by car and took him to the hospital.
Untungnya, kakinya tidak patah, tetapi dia harus beristirahat selama satu minggu.
Luckily his leg wasn't broken, but he had to rest for a week.
Sepedanya juga rusak, jadi ayahnya membawanya ke tukang sepeda.
His bike was damaged too, so his father took it to a bicycle repairman.
Sekarang Eko selalu memakai helm dan naik sepeda lebih pelan ketika jalan basah.
Now Eko always wears a helmet and rides more slowly when the road is wet.

questions.q: Mengapa jalannya basah?
questions.en: Why was the road wet?

questions.q: Eko jatuh karena seekor anjing.
questions.en: Eko fell because of a dog.

questions.q: Siapa yang membawa Eko ke rumah sakit?
questions.en: Who took Eko to the hospital?

questions.q: Kaki Eko patah.
questions.en: Eko's leg was broken.

questions.q: Sekarang Eko naik sepeda lebih cepat daripada dulu.
questions.en: Now Eko rides his bike faster than before.

passages.title: Kelas bahasa Inggris untuk orang dewasa
sentences: Apakah Anda ingin belajar bahasa Inggris, tetapi tidak punya waktu pada siang hari?
Do you want to learn English but have no time during the day?
Pusat bahasa "Cerdas" membuka kelas baru untuk orang dewasa mulai bulan Maret.
The "Cerdas" language centre is opening new classes for adults from March.
Kelas diadakan dua kali seminggu, pada hari Selasa dan Kamis, dari pukul tujuh sampai pukul sembilan malam.
Classes are held twice a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, from seven to nine in the evening.
Setiap kelas hanya punya sepuluh murid, jadi guru bisa membantu setiap orang.
Each class has only ten students, so the teacher can help everyone.
Semua guru kami punya pengalaman lebih dari lima tahun.
All our teachers have more than five years' experience.
Di kelas, Anda akan belajar berbicara di kantor, di hotel, dan di bandara.
In class you will learn to speak at the office, at a hotel and at the airport.
Biaya kelas satu juta untuk tiga bulan, termasuk buku.
The fee is one million for three months, including books.
Sebelum kelas mulai, Anda harus mengikuti tes kecil untuk memilih kelas yang cocok.
Before classes start, you must take a short test to choose the right class.
Tes ini gratis.
This test is free.
Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, datang ke kantor kami di Jalan Diponegoro.
For more information, come to our office on Diponegoro Street.

questions.q: Untuk siapa kelas ini?
questions.en: Who are these classes for?

questions.q: Kelas diadakan setiap hari.
questions.en: Classes are held every day.

questions.q: Mengapa setiap kelas hanya punya sepuluh murid?
questions.en: Why does each class only have ten students?
options: Supaya guru bisa membantu setiap orang
Karena ruang kelasnya tidak terlalu besar

questions.q: Biaya kelas termasuk buku.
questions.en: The fee includes books.

questions.q: Anda harus membayar untuk tes sebelum kelas.
questions.en: You have to pay for the test before the classes.

passages.title: Surat dari Belanda
sentences: Halo Sari,
Hello Sari,
Sudah tiga bulan saya tinggal di Belanda, dan saya mau menceritakan sedikit tentang kehidupan saya di sini.
I've been living in the Netherlands for three months, and I want to tell you a little about my life here.
Kota tempat saya tinggal kecil, tetapi sangat indah dan bersih.
The town where I live is small, but very beautiful and clean.
Hampir semua orang naik sepeda, bahkan orang yang sudah tua dan anak kecil.
Almost everyone rides a bicycle, even old people and small children.
Saya juga sudah membeli sepeda bekas, jadi setiap hari saya naik sepeda ke universitas.
I've also bought a second-hand bicycle, so every day I cycle to university.
Cuacanya sering dingin dan banyak angin, dan matahari jarang muncul.
The weather is often cold and windy, and the sun rarely comes out.
Saya sangat rindu nasi dan makanan pedas dari rumah!
I really miss rice and spicy food from home!
Untungnya, ada toko Indonesia dekat stasiun, jadi kadang-kadang saya bisa memasak sendiri.
Luckily there is an Indonesian shop near the station, so sometimes I can cook for myself.
Bulan depan saya akan mengunjungi sebuah museum terkenal di Amsterdam dengan teman-teman kelas.
Next month I will visit a famous museum in Amsterdam with classmates.
Tolong sampaikan salam saya untuk keluargamu.
Please give my regards to your family.
Salam, Dian
Regards, Dian

questions.q: Dian sudah tinggal di Belanda selama satu tahun.
questions.en: Dian has lived in the Netherlands for a year.

questions.q: Bagaimana Dian pergi ke universitas?
questions.en: How does Dian get to university?

questions.q: Di mana toko Indonesia itu?
questions.en: Where is the Indonesian shop?

questions.q: Dian kadang-kadang bisa memasak makanan Indonesia.
questions.en: Dian can sometimes cook Indonesian food.

passages.title: Tujuh belas Agustus di desa
sentences: Setiap tanggal tujuh belas Agustus, orang Indonesia mengadakan pesta besar untuk Hari Kemerdekaan.
Every 17 August, Indonesians hold a big celebration for Independence Day.
Di desa Pak Joko, acaranya selalu sangat menyenangkan.
In Mr Joko's village the event is always a lot of fun.
Seminggu sebelumnya, warga memasang bendera merah putih di depan setiap rumah.
A week before, residents put up red and white flags in front of every house.
Pada pagi hari, semua orang berkumpul di depan sekolah untuk upacara.
In the morning everyone gathers in front of the school for a ceremony.
Setelah itu, ada banyak permainan untuk anak-anak dan orang dewasa.
After that there are lots of games for children and adults.
Anak-anak mencoba makan kerupuk dengan cepat tanpa memakai tangan.
The children try to eat crackers as fast as possible without using their hands.
Para bapak bermain sepak bola dengan memakai baju perempuan, dan semua orang tertawa melihat mereka jatuh.
The men play football wearing women's clothes, and everyone laughs watching them fall.
Tim yang menang mendapat hadiah seperti sepeda, radio, atau tas.
The winning team gets prizes such as a bicycle, a radio or bags.
Malamnya, ada makan bersama dan musik di depan kantor kepala desa.
In the evening there is a shared meal and music in front of the village head's office.
Pada hari itu, semua warga merasa seperti satu keluarga besar.
On that day all the residents feel like one big family.

questions.q: Apa yang dipasang di depan rumah?
questions.en: What is put up in front of the houses?

questions.q: Upacara diadakan pada malam hari.
questions.en: The ceremony is held in the evening.

questions.q: Apa yang dipakai para bapak ketika bermain sepak bola?
questions.en: What do the men wear when they play football?

questions.q: Tim yang kalah juga mendapat sepeda.
questions.en: The losing team also gets a bicycle.

questions.q: Pada malam hari, warga makan bersama.
questions.en: In the evening the residents eat together.

passages.title: Masalah dengan ponsel
sentences: Kemarin ponsel saya mati dan tidak mau menyala lagi.
Yesterday my phone died and wouldn't turn on again.
Tetapi baterainya masih penuh.
But the battery was still full.
Saya mencoba menekan semua tombol, tetapi ponselnya tetap mati.
I tried pressing all the buttons, but the phone stayed dead.
Semua foto dan nomor telepon teman-teman saya ada di ponsel itu!
All my photos and my friends' phone numbers were on that phone!
Saya membawa ponsel itu ke toko tempat saya membelinya tahun lalu.
I took the phone to the shop where I bought it last year.
Petugas di toko memeriksanya dan berkata bahwa ada masalah dengan programnya.
The staff member at the shop checked it and said there was a problem with its software.
Dia bisa memperbaikinya dalam dua hari, dan perbaikannya gratis karena ponsel saya masih baru.
They could repair it in two days, and the repair was free because my phone was still new.
Selama dua hari itu, saya tidak bisa menelepon atau membaca pesan.
For those two days I couldn't phone or read messages.
Awalnya saya bingung, tetapi kemudian saya membaca buku dan tidur lebih awal.
At first I was confused, but then I read a book and went to bed earlier.
Ternyata hidup tanpa ponsel tidak terlalu buruk.
It turns out life without a phone isn't too bad.

questions.q: Ponsel itu mati karena baterainya habis.
questions.en: The phone died because the battery ran out.

questions.q: Ke mana dia membawa ponselnya?
questions.en: Where did he take his phone?
options: Ke rumah temannya di dekat stasiun

questions.q: Berapa lama perbaikan ponselnya?
questions.en: How long did the phone repair take?

questions.q: Dia harus membayar untuk memperbaiki ponselnya.
questions.en: He had to pay to repair his phone.

questions.q: Tanpa ponsel, dia tidur lebih awal.
questions.en: Without his phone, he went to bed earlier.

passages.title: Keputusan yang sulit
sentences: Setelah lulus dari universitas, Hendra mendapat dua tawaran kerja pada minggu yang sama.
After graduating from university, Hendra got two job offers in the same week.
Yang pertama dari sebuah bank besar di Jakarta, dengan gaji yang tinggi dan kantor yang modern.
The first was from a big bank in Jakarta, with a high salary and a modern office.
Yang kedua dari sebuah organisasi kecil di Flores yang membantu petani kopi menjual kopi mereka.
The second was from a small organisation in Flores that helps coffee farmers sell their coffee.
Gajinya jauh lebih rendah, dan dia harus tinggal jauh dari keluarganya.
The salary was much lower, and he would have to live far from his family.
Orang tuanya ingin dia memilih bank, karena menurut mereka pekerjaan itu lebih aman untuk masa depannya.
His parents wanted him to choose the bank, because in their opinion that job was safer for his future.
Tetapi Hendra selalu tertarik pada pertanian, dan dia ingin pekerjaannya bermanfaat untuk orang lain.
But Hendra had always been interested in agriculture, and he wanted his work to be useful to others.
Dia berbicara dengan seorang dosen yang pernah bekerja di Flores selama lima tahun.
He talked with a lecturer who had once worked in Flores for five years.
Dosen itu berkata bahwa hidup di sana tidak mudah, tetapi pengalamannya sangat berharga.
The lecturer said that life there was not easy, but the experience was very valuable.
Akhirnya Hendra memilih organisasi kecil itu, dengan janji kepada orang tuanya bahwa dia akan pulang setiap Lebaran.
In the end Hendra chose the small organisation, promising his parents that he would come home every Eid.
Sekarang, setelah satu tahun, dia tidak menyesali keputusannya.
Now, after one year, he does not regret his decision.

questions.q: Apa kelebihan pekerjaan di bank?
questions.en: What was the advantage of the job at the bank?

questions.q: Organisasi di Flores membantu petani menjual kopi.
questions.en: The organisation in Flores helps farmers sell coffee.

questions.q: Mengapa orang tua Hendra ingin dia bekerja di bank?
questions.en: Why did Hendra's parents want him to work at the bank?

questions.q: Menurut dosen itu, hidup di Flores tidak mudah.
questions.en: According to the lecturer, life in Flores is not easy.

questions.q: Hendra sekarang menyesal karena tidak memilih bank.
questions.en: Hendra now regrets not choosing the bank.

passages.title: Keluhan untuk hotel
sentences: Kepada Yth. Manajer Hotel Melati,
To the manager of the Melati Hotel,
Saya menginap di hotel Anda dari tanggal tiga sampai lima Mei bersama istri dan dua anak saya.
I stayed at your hotel from the third to the fifth of May with my wife and two children.
Saya memesan kamar keluarga dengan pemandangan laut lewat situs hotel dua bulan sebelumnya.
I booked a family room with a sea view on the hotel's website two months in advance.
Namun, ketika kami tiba, petugas berkata bahwa kamar itu tidak tersedia, dan kami diberi dua kamar kecil di lantai satu yang menghadap ke tempat parkir.
However, when we arrived, the receptionist said that the room was not available, and we were given two small rooms on the ground floor facing the car park.
Selain itu, air panas di kamar mandi tidak keluar selama dua hari, dan lampu di kamar anak-anak rusak.
In addition, no hot water came out in the bathroom for two days, and the light in the children's room was broken.
Saya sudah menyampaikan masalah ini kepada petugas beberapa kali, tetapi tidak ada yang datang untuk memperbaikinya.
I reported these problems to the staff several times, but nobody came to repair them.
Sarapannya enak dan pegawai restoran sangat ramah, tetapi pengalaman kami secara umum mengecewakan.
Breakfast was good and the restaurant staff were very friendly, but on the whole our experience was disappointing.
Kami membayar harga kamar dengan pemandangan laut, jadi saya meminta hotel mengembalikan sebagian uang kami.
We paid the price of a sea-view room, so I am asking the hotel to return part of our money.
Saya menunggu balasan Anda.
I look forward to your reply.
Hormat saya, Bambang Susilo
Yours faithfully, Bambang Susilo

questions.q: Kamar apa yang dipesan Bambang?
questions.en: What room did Bambang book?
options: Kamar di dekat tempat parkir mobil

questions.q: Keluarga itu mendapat kamar yang mereka pesan.
questions.en: The family got the room they booked.

questions.q: Masalah apa yang ada di kamar mandi?
questions.en: What problem was there in the bathroom?

questions.q: Menurut Bambang, pegawai restoran baik kepada tamu.
questions.en: According to Bambang, the restaurant staff were nice to guests.

questions.q: Bambang ingin hotel mengembalikan semua uangnya.
questions.en: Bambang wants the hotel to return all of his money.

passages.title: Pabrik tua akan ditutup
sentences: Pabrik kain di tepi kota Bandung, yang sudah berdiri sejak tahun 1970, akan ditutup pada akhir tahun ini.
The textile factory on the edge of Bandung, which has stood since 1970, will close at the end of this year.
Menurut pemiliknya, perusahaan itu mengalami kerugian selama tiga tahun terakhir karena harga bahan naik dan kain dari luar negeri lebih murah.
According to its owner, the company has made a loss for the last three years because the price of materials rose and cloth from abroad is cheaper.
Sekitar empat ratus pekerja akan kehilangan pekerjaan mereka.
About four hundred workers will lose their jobs.
Banyak dari mereka sudah bekerja di sana lebih dari dua puluh tahun.
Many of them have worked there for more than twenty years.
"Saya tidak tahu harus bekerja di mana lagi pada umur lima puluh," kata Ibu Ratna, yang menjahit di pabrik itu sejak muda.
"I don't know where else I can work at fifty," said Mrs Ratna, who has sewn at the factory since she was young.
Pemerintah kota berjanji akan membantu para pekerja dengan pelatihan gratis dan informasi tentang pekerjaan di perusahaan lain.
The city government has promised to help the workers with free training and information about jobs at other companies.
Beberapa warga berharap gedung pabrik itu tidak dihancurkan, tetapi diubah menjadi pasar atau pusat kegiatan untuk anak muda.
Some residents hope the factory building will not be demolished, but turned into a market or a centre for young people's activities.
Keputusan tentang gedung itu akan diambil tahun depan.
The decision about the building will be taken next year.

questions.q: Mengapa pabrik itu ditutup?
questions.en: Why is the factory closing?

questions.q: Banyak pekerja sudah lama bekerja di pabrik itu.
questions.en: Many workers have worked at the factory for a long time.

questions.q: Apa janji pemerintah kota?
questions.en: What is the city government's promise?
options: Gedung baru untuk anak muda kota

questions.q: Ada warga yang ingin gedung pabrik itu dijadikan pasar.
questions.en: Some residents want the factory building to become a market.

questions.q: Keputusan tentang gedung itu sudah diambil.
questions.en: The decision about the building has already been made.

passages.title: Masa kecil kakek saya
sentences: Kakek saya lahir di sebuah desa kecil di Jawa Tengah pada tahun 1950.
My grandfather was born in a small village in Central Java in 1950.
Waktu itu desanya belum punya listrik, jadi pada malam hari keluarganya memakai lampu minyak.
At that time his village had no electricity yet, so at night his family used oil lamps.
Setiap pagi, sebelum sekolah, dia harus membawa kambing-kambing ayahnya ke lapangan dan mengambil air dari sungai.
Every morning before school he had to take his father's goats to the field and fetch water from the river.
Sekolahnya jauh, dan dia berjalan kaki hampir satu jam tanpa sepatu.
His school was far away, and he walked almost an hour without shoes.
Kakek bercerita bahwa dia hanya punya dua baju dan satu buku tulis, yang harus dia jaga dengan baik.
Grandfather told us that he had only two shirts and one exercise book, which he had to look after carefully.
Mainan mereka dibuat sendiri dari kayu.
Their toys were home-made from wood.
Walaupun hidupnya susah, dia berkata bahwa masa kecilnya bahagia karena semua anak di desa bermain bersama dan saling membantu.
Although life was hard, he says his childhood was happy because all the children in the village played together and helped each other.
Ketika dia berumur delapan belas tahun, dia pindah ke Semarang untuk bekerja di sebuah toko.
When he was eighteen, he moved to Semarang to work in a shop.
Sekarang Kakek sering berkata kepada kami bahwa anak-anak zaman sekarang sangat beruntung.
Now Grandfather often tells us that children these days are very lucky.

questions.q: Ketika kakeknya kecil, desanya sudah punya listrik.
questions.en: When his grandfather was small, the village already had electricity.

questions.q: Apa yang harus dia lakukan setiap pagi sebelum sekolah?
questions.en: What did he have to do every morning before school?

questions.q: Bagaimana dia pergi ke sekolah?
questions.en: How did he get to school?

questions.q: Mainan anak-anak di desa itu dibeli di kota.
questions.en: The village children's toys were bought in town.

questions.q: Menurut kakek, anak-anak sekarang beruntung.
questions.en: According to Grandfather, children today are lucky.

passages.title: Bagaimana cara tidur lebih baik?
sentences: Banyak orang dewasa di kota besar mengeluh bahwa mereka sulit tidur atau sering bangun pada malam hari.
Many adults in big cities complain that they find it hard to sleep or often wake up at night.
Menurut para ahli, orang dewasa membutuhkan tujuh sampai delapan jam tidur setiap malam.
According to experts, adults need seven to eight hours of sleep every night.
Kurang tidur bisa membuat kita lelah, sulit berpikir, dan lebih cepat marah.
Lack of sleep can make us tired, unable to think clearly and quicker to anger.
Ada beberapa kebiasaan sederhana yang bisa membantu.
There are some simple habits that can help.
Pertama, cobalah tidur dan bangun pada jam yang sama setiap hari, juga pada akhir pekan.
First, try to go to bed and get up at the same time every day, including at weekends.
Kedua, jangan minum kopi atau teh setelah pukul empat sore.
Second, don't drink coffee or tea after four in the afternoon.
Ketiga, matikan ponsel dan televisi satu jam sebelum tidur, karena cahaya dari ponsel dan televisi membuat otak tetap aktif.
Third, turn off your phone and television an hour before bed, because the light from phones and televisions keeps the brain active.
Kamar tidur juga harus gelap, tenang, dan tidak terlalu panas.
The bedroom should also be dark, quiet and not too hot.
Olahraga ringan pada pagi atau sore hari juga bermanfaat, tetapi sebaiknya tidak dilakukan larut malam.
Light exercise in the morning or afternoon is also useful, but it is better not to do it late at night.
Kalau masalah tidur Anda berlangsung lebih dari sebulan, sebaiknya Anda pergi ke dokter.
If your sleep problem lasts more than a month, you should see a doctor.

questions.q: Kurang tidur bisa membuat orang cepat marah.
questions.en: Lack of sleep can make people quick to anger.

questions.q: Setelah pukul berapa kita sebaiknya tidak minum kopi?
questions.en: After what time should we not drink coffee?

questions.q: Mengapa ponsel harus dimatikan sebelum tidur?
questions.en: Why should phones be turned off before bed?
options: Ponsel bisa rusak pada malam hari

questions.q: Kamar tidur sebaiknya panas dan terang.
questions.en: The bedroom should be hot and bright.

questions.q: Artikel ini menyarankan olahraga larut malam.
questions.en: This article recommends exercising late at night.

passages.title: Hari Sabtu di perpustakaan
sentences: Perpustakaan kota di Jalan Veteran baru saja dibuka kembali setelah diperbaiki selama enam bulan.
The city library on Veteran Street has just reopened after six months of renovation.
Sekarang gedungnya lebih terang, dan ada ruang baca yang luas dengan kursi yang nyaman.
The building is now brighter, and there is a large reading room with comfortable chairs.
Selain buku, perpustakaan menyediakan komputer, internet gratis, dan koleksi film Indonesia lama.
Besides books, the library provides computers, free internet and a collection of old Indonesian films.
Setiap Sabtu pagi, ada kegiatan membaca cerita untuk anak-anak, dan orang tua boleh ikut.
Every Saturday morning there is a story-reading session for children, and parents may join in.
Pada sore hari, para pelajar bisa mendapat bantuan untuk tugas sekolah mereka, seperti matematika dan bahasa Inggris.
In the afternoon students can get help with their schoolwork, such as maths and English.
Kepala perpustakaan, Ibu Yanti, berkata bahwa sejak gedung dibuka kembali, jumlah orang yang datang setiap hari naik dari seratus menjadi dua ratus.
The head librarian, Mrs Yanti, said that since the building reopened, the number of people coming each day has risen from one hundred to two hundred.
"Dulu anak muda jarang datang ke sini. Sekarang mereka datang untuk belajar bersama dan mengerjakan proyek," katanya.
"Young people used to come here rarely. Now they come to study together and work on projects," she said.
Untuk menjadi anggota, Anda hanya perlu membawa kartu identitas.
To become a member, you only need to bring an identity card.
Anggota boleh meminjam lima buku selama dua minggu.
Members may borrow five books for two weeks.

questions.q: Perpustakaan itu tutup selama enam bulan.
questions.en: The library was closed for six months.

questions.q: Apa yang disediakan perpustakaan selain buku?
questions.en: What does the library provide besides books?
options: Tempat parkir yang luas dan gratis

questions.q: Kapan ada kegiatan membaca cerita untuk anak-anak?
questions.en: When is there a story-reading session for children?

questions.q: Menurut Ibu Yanti, sekarang lebih sedikit orang datang ke perpustakaan.
questions.en: According to Mrs Yanti, fewer people now come to the library.

questions.q: Berapa buku yang boleh dipinjam anggota?
questions.en: How many books may members borrow?

passages.title: Mengurangi mobil di pusat kota
sentences: Mulai bulan depan, pemerintah kota Yogyakarta akan menutup Jalan Malioboro untuk mobil dan motor setiap akhir pekan.
From next month, the Yogyakarta city government will close Malioboro Street to cars and motorbikes every weekend.
Tujuannya adalah mengurangi kemacetan dan membuat udara di pusat kota lebih bersih.
The aim is to reduce traffic jams and make the air in the city centre cleaner.
Pada hari Sabtu dan Minggu, hanya orang yang berjalan kaki atau naik sepeda dan kendaraan listrik kecil yang boleh masuk.
On Saturday and Sunday only people on foot or on bicycles, and small electric vehicles, will be allowed in.
Pemerintah juga menambah bus gratis dari tempat parkir besar di luar pusat kota.
The government is also adding free buses from large car parks outside the city centre.
Banyak warga mendukung rencana ini.
Many residents support this plan.
"Sekarang anak-anak bisa berjalan dengan aman, dan kita bisa menikmati suasana kota," kata seorang guru.
"Now children can walk safely, and we can enjoy the atmosphere of the city," said a teacher.
Namun, beberapa pemilik toko khawatir bahwa pelanggan mereka akan berkurang karena tidak bisa parkir di depan toko.
However, some shop owners are worried that they will have fewer customers because people cannot park in front of the shops.
Pemerintah menjawab bahwa di kota-kota lain, jumlah pelanggan naik setelah jalan ditutup untuk kendaraan.
The government replied that in other cities, the number of customers rose after streets were closed to vehicles.
Rencana ini akan dicoba selama enam bulan, lalu hasilnya akan dibahas bersama warga.
The plan will be tried for six months, and then the results will be discussed with residents.

questions.q: Kapan jalan itu ditutup untuk mobil dan motor?
questions.en: When will the street be closed to cars and motorbikes?

questions.q: Salah satu tujuan rencana ini adalah udara yang lebih bersih.
questions.en: One of the plan's aims is cleaner air.

questions.q: Apa yang ditambah pemerintah?
questions.en: What is the government adding?

questions.q: Semua pemilik toko senang dengan rencana ini.
questions.en: All the shop owners are happy with this plan.

questions.q: Rencana itu akan dicoba selama setengah tahun.
questions.en: The plan will be tried for half a year.

passages.title: Perjalanan pertama saya sendirian
sentences: Tahun lalu, ketika saya berumur sembilan belas tahun, saya bepergian sendirian untuk pertama kalinya.
Last year, when I was nineteen, I travelled alone for the first time.
Saya naik kapal dari Surabaya ke Makassar, dan perjalanannya hampir dua hari.
I took a ship from Surabaya to Makassar, and the journey took almost two days.
Sebelum berangkat, ibu saya sangat khawatir dan memberi saya daftar panjang berisi nasihat.
Before I left, my mother was very worried and gave me a long list of advice.
Di kapal, saya berbagi kamar dengan tiga penumpang lain yang tidak saya kenal.
On the ship I shared a cabin with three other passengers I didn't know.
Awalnya saya gugup, tetapi mereka ternyata sangat ramah.
At first I was nervous, but they turned out to be very friendly.
Salah satu dari mereka, seorang nenek dari Makassar, mengajari saya beberapa kata dalam bahasa Bugis dan berbagi kue buatannya dengan kami.
One of them, a grandmother from Makassar, taught me a few words of Buginese and shared her home-made cakes with us.
Pada malam kedua, laut agak kasar, dan banyak orang mabuk laut, termasuk saya.
On the second night the sea was rather rough, and many people were seasick, including me.
Ketika akhirnya tiba di Makassar, sepupu saya sudah menunggu di pelabuhan.
When I finally arrived in Makassar, my cousin was already waiting at the port.
Perjalanan itu mengajari saya bahwa saya bisa mengurus diri sendiri dan bahwa orang asing sering lebih baik daripada yang kita kira.
The trip taught me that I can look after myself and that strangers are often kinder than we think.

questions.q: Bagaimana dia pergi ke Makassar?
questions.en: How did he travel to Makassar?

questions.q: Ibunya tidak khawatir sama sekali.
questions.en: His mother wasn't worried at all.

questions.q: Apa yang dilakukan nenek dari Makassar?
questions.en: What did the grandmother from Makassar do?

questions.q: Pada malam kedua, dia sakit karena laut tidak tenang.
questions.en: On the second night he was ill because the sea was not calm.

questions.q: Siapa yang menunggu dia di Makassar?
questions.en: Who was waiting for him in Makassar?

passages.title: Anak muda dan ponsel
sentences: Sebuah studi baru di Indonesia menunjukkan bahwa remaja menggunakan ponsel sekitar tujuh jam sehari.
A new study in Indonesia shows that teenagers use their phones about seven hours a day.
Sebagian besar waktu itu dipakai untuk media sosial, video, dan permainan.
Most of that time is spent on social media, videos and games.
Banyak orang tua khawatir karena anak-anak mereka jarang berbicara di rumah dan tidur terlalu larut.
Many parents are worried because their children rarely talk at home and go to bed too late.
Beberapa guru juga melaporkan bahwa murid-murid sulit fokus di kelas.
Some teachers also report that pupils find it hard to focus in class.
Namun, para ahli berkata bahwa ponsel tidak selalu buruk.
However, experts say that phones are not always bad.
Remaja bisa belajar bahasa, mencari informasi untuk tugas sekolah, dan tetap berhubungan dengan teman-teman yang tinggal jauh.
Teenagers can learn languages, look up information for schoolwork and stay in touch with friends who live far away.
Yang penting adalah tidak memakainya terlalu lama.
What matters is not using them for too long.
Para ahli menyarankan agar keluarga membuat aturan bersama, misalnya tidak ada ponsel saat makan malam atau di kamar tidur setelah pukul sembilan.
Experts suggest that families make rules together, for example no phones at dinner or in the bedroom after nine o'clock.
Orang tua juga harus memberi contoh yang baik, karena anak-anak sering meniru apa yang mereka lihat.
Parents must also set a good example, because children often copy what they see.

questions.q: Berapa lama remaja memakai ponsel setiap hari?
questions.en: How long do teenagers use their phones each day?

questions.q: Guru-guru berkata bahwa murid-murid mudah fokus di kelas.
questions.en: Teachers say pupils find it easy to focus in class.

questions.q: Menurut para ahli, ponsel juga bisa berguna.
questions.en: According to experts, phones can also be useful.

questions.q: Apa contoh aturan yang disarankan para ahli?
questions.en: What is an example of a rule the experts suggest?
options: Ponsel hanya boleh dipakai pada akhir pekan
Ponsel tidak dipakai ketika makan malam

questions.q: Anak-anak sering meniru orang tua mereka.
questions.en: Children often copy their parents.

passages.title: Surat tentang tetangga baru
sentences: Yth. Bapak Ketua RT,
Dear Head of the Neighbourhood Association,
Saya tinggal di rumah nomor dua belas, Jalan Mawar.
I live at number twelve, Mawar Street.
Dengan surat ini saya ingin menyampaikan keluhan tentang suara keras dari rumah nomor lima belas.
With this letter I would like to make a complaint about loud noise from house number fifteen.
Selama dua bulan terakhir, orang yang baru tinggal di rumah itu sering mengadakan acara sampai jam dua atau tiga pagi.
For the last two months, the people who recently moved into that house have often held gatherings until two or three in the morning.
Mereka memutar musik dengan sangat keras dan berteriak di halaman.
They play music very loudly and shout in the yard.
Saya sudah dua kali datang dan meminta mereka dengan sopan untuk mengecilkan suara, tetapi keadaannya tidak berubah.
I have gone round twice and politely asked them to turn the volume down, but the situation has not changed.
Anak saya yang masih bayi sering terbangun, dan istri saya, yang bekerja sebagai perawat, tidak bisa beristirahat sebelum bekerja.
My baby often wakes up, and my wife, who works as a nurse, cannot rest before going to work.
Beberapa tetangga lain juga mengalami masalah yang sama.
Several other neighbours have the same problem.
Saya mohon Bapak dapat berbicara dengan mereka dan mengingatkan mereka tentang aturan kampung kita.
I ask you to talk to them and remind them of our neighbourhood rules.
Terima kasih atas perhatian Bapak.
Thank you for your attention.

questions.q: Tentang apa keluhan ini?
questions.en: What is this complaint about?
options: Mobil yang parkir di depan rumah

questions.q: Masalah ini sering terjadi selama dua bulan terakhir.
questions.en: This problem has often happened over the last two months.

questions.en: The letter writer has already spoken to his neighbours.

questions.q: Apa pekerjaan istri penulis?
questions.en: What is the writer's wife's job?

questions.q: Hanya penulis surat yang merasa terganggu.
questions.en: Only the letter writer feels disturbed.

passages.title: Berganti pekerjaan pada umur empat puluh
sentences: Selama lima belas tahun, Wulan bekerja di bagian keuangan sebuah bank di Jakarta.
For fifteen years Wulan worked in the finance department of a bank in Jakarta.
Gajinya bagus, tetapi dia merasa bosan dan lelah karena setiap hari hanya duduk di depan komputer.
Her salary was good, but she felt bored and tired because every day she just sat in front of a computer.
Sejak kecil, dia suka membuat kue, dan teman-temannya selalu berkata bahwa kue buatannya paling enak.
Since childhood she had liked baking, and her friends always said her cakes were the best.
Ketika berumur empat puluh tahun, dia memutuskan untuk berhenti bekerja dan membuka toko kue kecil di dekat rumahnya.
When she was forty, she decided to quit her job and open a small cake shop near her home.
Keluarganya terkejut, dan suaminya awalnya tidak setuju karena mereka masih harus membayar sekolah anak-anak.
Her family was surprised, and her husband at first disagreed because they still had to pay for the children's school.
Wulan mengikuti pelatihan bisnis selama enam bulan dan menyimpan uang untuk membeli peralatan dapur.
Wulan took business training for six months and put money aside to buy kitchen equipment.
Tahun pertama sangat sulit: dia bekerja dari pukul empat pagi sampai malam, dan tokonya sering kosong.
The first year was very hard: she worked from four in the morning until night, and the shop was often empty.
Tetapi setelah seorang pelanggan menulis komentar yang bagus di internet, semakin banyak orang datang.
But after a customer wrote a good comment on the internet, more and more people came.
Sekarang Wulan punya tiga pegawai, dan dia merasa lebih bahagia daripada sebelumnya.
Now Wulan has three employees, and she feels happier than before.

questions.q: Mengapa Wulan tidak senang dengan pekerjaannya di bank?
questions.en: Why was Wulan unhappy with her job at the bank?

questions.q: Suami Wulan langsung setuju dengan rencananya.
questions.en: Wulan's husband agreed with her plan straight away.

questions.q: Apa yang Wulan lakukan sebelum membuka toko?
questions.en: What did Wulan do before opening the shop?

questions.q: Pada tahun pertama, toko Wulan selalu penuh.
questions.en: In the first year, Wulan's shop was always full.

questions.q: Sebuah komentar di internet membantu toko Wulan.
questions.en: A comment on the internet helped Wulan's shop.

passages.title: Kebun di atas atap
sentences: Di tengah kota Jakarta yang padat, sebuah sekolah dasar membuat kebun sayur di atas atap gedungnya.
In the middle of crowded Jakarta, a primary school has made a vegetable garden on the roof of its building.
Idenya datang dari seorang guru ilmu alam, Pak Rahmat, yang ingin murid-muridnya belajar tentang alam secara langsung.
The idea came from a science teacher, Mr Rahmat, who wanted his pupils to learn about nature first-hand.
Bersama orang tua murid, dia membawa tanah, kotak-kotak kayu, dan tanaman kecil ke atap.
Together with the pupils' parents, he took soil, wooden boxes and small plants up to the roof.
Setiap kelas mengurus satu bagian kebun.
Each class looks after one part of the garden.
Anak-anak memberi air pada tanaman setiap pagi dan menulis di buku berapa cepat tanaman itu tumbuh.
The children water the plants every morning and write in a notebook how quickly they grow.
Air hujan disimpan di beberapa tempat besar, jadi sekolah tidak perlu membayar banyak untuk air.
Rainwater is stored in several large containers, so the school doesn't need to pay much for water.
Setelah tiga bulan, mereka mengambil sayur pertama dari kebun itu.
After three months they picked the first vegetables from the garden.
Sebagian sayur dimasak di dapur sekolah untuk makan siang, dan sebagian lagi dijual kepada orang tua.
Some of the vegetables are cooked in the school kitchen for lunch, and the rest are sold to parents.
Uangnya dipakai untuk membeli tanaman baru.
The money is used to buy new plants.
Menurut Pak Rahmat, sekarang murid-murid lebih suka makan sayur karena mereka menanamnya sendiri.
According to Mr Rahmat, the pupils now like eating vegetables more because they grew them themselves.

questions.q: Ide kebun itu datang dari kepala sekolah.
questions.en: The idea for the garden came from the head teacher.

questions.q: Siapa yang membantu Pak Rahmat membawa tanah ke atap?
questions.en: Who helped Mr Rahmat take soil up to the roof?

questions.q: Apa yang dilakukan anak-anak setiap pagi?
questions.en: What do the children do every morning?

questions.q: Sekolah menyimpan air hujan.
questions.en: The school stores rainwater.

questions.q: Menurut Pak Rahmat, murid-murid sekarang lebih suka makan sayur.
questions.en: According to Mr Rahmat, the pupils now prefer to eat vegetables.

passages.title: Lomba memasak di kampung

oop.rendang: rendang (Padang beef dish): no pack word

sentences: Bulan lalu, kampung kami mengadakan lomba memasak untuk merayakan ulang tahun kota.
Last month our neighbourhood held a cooking competition to celebrate the town's anniversary.
Setiap orang yang ikut harus memasak hidangan tradisional dari daerah asalnya dalam waktu dua jam.
Everyone who took part had to cook a traditional dish from their home region within two hours.
Ada dua puluh orang yang ikut, dari anak muda sampai nenek-nenek.
Twenty people took part, from young people to grandmothers.
Tiga orang memberi nilai: seorang ahli masak dari hotel, seorang penulis buku resep, dan kepala kampung.
Three people gave the marks: a cooking expert from a hotel, a cookbook writer and the neighbourhood head.
Mereka memberi nilai untuk rasa, penampilan, dan tempat memasak yang bersih.
They gave marks for taste, appearance and a clean cooking area.
Tetangga saya, Pak Dedi, membuat sup ayam dengan resep dari ibunya.
My neighbour, Mr Dedi, made chicken soup with his mother's recipe.
Supnya enak sekali, tetapi dia terlambat lima menit, jadi nilainya dikurangi.
His soup was really delicious, but he was five minutes late, so points were taken off.
Yang menang adalah seorang mahasiswa dari Padang yang memasak rendang daging dengan rasa yang pedas dan lezat.
The winner was a university student from Padang who cooked beef rendang with a spicy, delicious taste.
Dia mendapat hadiah uang dan kesempatan memasak di restoran hotel selama seminggu.
She won prize money and the chance to cook in the hotel restaurant for a week.
Setelah lomba, semua orang mencoba makanan bersama, dan tidak ada sisa sedikit pun.
After the competition everyone tried the food together, and there wasn't a scrap left.

questions.q: Apa yang harus dimasak setiap orang?
questions.en: What did everyone have to cook?

questions.q: Nilai hanya diberikan untuk rasa makanan.
questions.en: Marks were only given for the taste of the food.

questions.q: Mengapa nilai Pak Dedi dikurangi?
questions.en: Why were Mr Dedi's points reduced?

questions.q: Seorang mahasiswa dari Padang menang lomba itu.
questions.en: A university student from Padang won the competition.

questions.q: Setelah lomba, banyak makanan yang tidak dimakan.
questions.en: After the competition, a lot of food was not eaten.

passages.title: Pernikahan sepupu saya
sentences: Minggu lalu saya pergi ke Medan untuk menghadiri pernikahan sepupu saya, Tika.
Last week I went to Medan to attend my cousin Tika's wedding.
Pernikahannya diadakan dengan adat Batak, jadi acaranya berlangsung hampir sehari penuh.
The wedding was held according to Batak custom, so the event lasted almost a whole day.
Pada pagi hari, keluarga pengantin laki-laki datang ke rumah Tika dengan membawa makanan dan hadiah.
In the morning the groom's family came to Tika's house bringing food and gifts.
Setelah upacara di gereja, semua tamu pergi ke sebuah gedung besar untuk pesta.
After the ceremony at the church, all the guests went to a large hall for the reception.
Ada lebih dari lima ratus tamu, dan sebagian besar dari mereka adalah saudara.
There were more than five hundred guests, and most of them were relatives.
Selama berjam-jam, keluarga memberi nasihat kepada pasangan baru itu, sambil menari dengan musik tradisional.
For hours the family gave advice to the new couple, while dancing to traditional music.
Saya belum pernah melihat pesta sebesar itu, dan saya agak bingung karena tidak tahu semua aturannya.
I had never seen a party that big, and I was a bit confused because I didn't know all the rules.
Untungnya, bibi saya menjelaskan arti setiap bagian acara.
Luckily my aunt explained the meaning of each part of the event.
Pada akhir hari, saya sangat lelah, tetapi saya senang bisa bertemu keluarga besar yang sudah lama tidak saya lihat.
At the end of the day I was very tired, but I was glad to see my extended family whom I hadn't seen for a long time.

questions.q: Di mana pernikahan itu diadakan?
questions.en: Where was the wedding held?

questions.q: Acara itu berlangsung hampir sepanjang hari.
questions.en: The event lasted almost all day.

questions.q: Siapa kebanyakan tamu di pesta itu?
questions.en: Who were most of the guests at the reception?

questions.q: Penulis tahu semua aturan acara itu.
questions.en: The writer knew all the rules of the event.

questions.q: Bibinya membantu dia mengerti acara itu.
questions.en: His aunt helped him understand the event.

passages.title: Museum buka sampai malam
sentences: Mulai bulan ini, Museum Nasional di Jakarta buka sampai pukul sembilan malam setiap Jumat dan Sabtu.
From this month, the National Museum in Jakarta is open until nine at night every Friday and Saturday.
Menurut kepala museum, banyak pekerja kantor tidak sempat datang pada siang hari, dan mereka ingin punya kesempatan untuk mengenal sejarah dan budaya Indonesia.
According to the museum's director, many office workers have no time to come during the day, and they want a chance to get to know Indonesian history and culture.
Pada malam hari, museum juga mengadakan acara khusus, seperti konser musik tradisional dan film.
In the evenings the museum also holds special events, such as traditional music concerts and films.
Harga tiket tetap sama, dan pelajar hanya membayar setengah harga.
Ticket prices stay the same, and students pay only half price.
Pada minggu pertama, lebih dari tiga ribu orang datang pada malam hari, kebanyakan anak muda.
In the first week more than three thousand people came in the evening, mostly young people.
"Saya tidak pernah ke museum lagi sejak SD," kata Rudi, seorang pegawai bank berumur dua puluh enam tahun.
"I never went to a museum again after primary school," said Rudi, a twenty-six-year-old bank employee.
"Ternyata menarik sekali, apalagi koleksi batu dan emas dari zaman kerajaan kuno."
"It turned out to be really interesting, especially the collection of stones and gold from the era of the ancient kingdoms."
Kepala museum berharap acara malam seperti ini bisa menjadi kebiasaan baru untuk warga kota.
The museum's director hopes these evening events can become a new habit for the city's residents.

questions.en: When is the museum open until night?

questions.en: How much do students pay?

questions.en: Most of the people who came in the evening were old.

questions.q: Rudi sering pergi ke museum.
questions.en: Rudi often goes to museums.

passages.title: Bekerja dari rumah
sentences: Sejak tiga tahun lalu, Yusuf bekerja dari rumah sebagai penerjemah untuk sebuah perusahaan di Singapura.
For the last three years Yusuf has worked from home as a translator for a company in Singapore.
Dia menerjemahkan dokumen dari bahasa Inggris ke bahasa Indonesia, dan semua pekerjaannya dikirim lewat internet.
He translates documents from English into Indonesian, and all his work is sent over the internet.
Ada banyak kelebihan: dia tidak perlu menghabiskan dua jam sehari di jalan, dan dia bisa makan siang bersama anak-anaknya.
There are many advantages: he doesn't need to spend two hours a day on the road, and he can have lunch with his children.
Namun, bekerja di rumah juga punya tantangan.
However, working at home also has its challenges.
Kadang-kadang sulit fokus karena anak-anak bermain di ruang sebelah atau tetangga sedang memperbaiki rumah.
Sometimes it is hard to focus because the children are playing in the next room or a neighbour is renovating.
Yusuf juga merasa kesepian karena jarang bertemu teman kerja.
Yusuf also feels lonely because he rarely meets colleagues.
Untuk mengatasi masalah ini, dia membuat jadwal yang ketat: mulai bekerja pukul delapan, istirahat pukul dua belas, dan selesai pukul lima.
To deal with these problems, he made a strict schedule: start work at eight, break at twelve and finish at five.
Dia juga menyewa meja di sebuah kantor bersama dua kali seminggu, supaya bisa bertemu orang lain.
He also rents a desk at a shared office twice a week, so he can meet other people.
Menurut Yusuf, kunci keberhasilannya adalah disiplin.
According to Yusuf, the key to his success is discipline.

questions.en: What is Yusuf's job?

questions.en: Yusuf doesn't need to go to an office every day.

questions.en: What does he do twice a week?

passages.title: Sepeda yang hilang
sentences: Hari Kamis lalu, sepeda baru saya hilang di depan perpustakaan kampus.
Last Thursday my new bicycle disappeared in front of the campus library.
Saya memarkirnya pukul sembilan pagi, dan ketika saya keluar pukul satu siang, sepeda itu sudah tidak ada.
I parked it at nine in the morning, and when I came out at one in the afternoon, it was gone.
Saya yakin saya sudah menguncinya, tetapi kuncinya ternyata tidak terlalu kuat.
I'm sure I had locked it, but the lock turned out not to be very strong.
Saya langsung melapor kepada petugas keamanan kampus, dan mereka memeriksa video dari kamera.
I immediately reported it to the campus security staff, and they checked the video from the camera.
Di video itu terlihat seorang laki-laki dengan jaket hitam yang membawa sepeda saya ke arah jalan besar.
The video showed a man in a black jacket taking my bicycle towards the main road.
Petugas menyarankan saya untuk melaporkan kejadian ini ke polisi juga.
The staff advised me to report the incident to the police as well.
Polisi menulis semua informasi, tetapi mereka berkata bahwa sepeda yang dicuri jarang ditemukan kembali.
The police took down all the information, but they said stolen bicycles are rarely found again.
Dua minggu kemudian, seorang teman melihat sepeda yang mirip dengan milik saya dijual di internet.
Two weeks later a friend saw a bicycle similar to mine being sold on the internet.
Kami memberi tahu polisi, dan akhirnya sepeda itu kembali kepada saya.
We told the police, and in the end the bicycle came back to me.
Sekarang saya memakai dua kunci yang besar.
Now I use two big locks.

questions.q: Sepedanya hilang pada pagi hari sebelum pukul sembilan.
questions.en: The bike disappeared in the morning before nine o'clock.

questions.en: What did the security staff check?

questions.en: What could be seen in the video?

questions.en: According to the police, stolen bicycles are usually found again.

questions.q: Seorang teman melihat di internet sepeda yang mirip dengan sepeda penulis.
questions.en: A friend saw a bicycle similar to the writer's on the internet.

passages.title: Makan siang di warung Bu Ningsih
sentences: Warung Bu Ningsih di dekat stasiun Bogor bukan restoran yang mahal, tetapi makanannya termasuk yang terbaik di kota ini.
Bu Ningsih's eatery near Bogor station is not an expensive restaurant, but its food is among the best in town.
Tempatnya sederhana: hanya ada enam meja kayu dan beberapa lampu tua.
The place is simple: there are just six wooden tables and a few old lamps.
Makanannya berubah setiap hari, tergantung sayur dan ikan yang segar di pasar pagi itu.
The food changes every day, depending on which vegetables and fish are fresh at the market that morning.
Saya memesan nasi dengan ikan bakar, sayur asam, dan sambal.
I ordered rice with grilled fish, sour vegetable soup and chilli sauce.
Ikannya dimasak dengan sempurna, dan sambalnya pedas tetapi tidak terlalu kuat.
The fish was cooked perfectly, and the chilli sauce was hot but not overpowering.
Pelayanannya cepat, dan Bu Ningsih sendiri sering datang ke meja untuk bertanya apakah tamunya puas.
Service is fast, and Bu Ningsih herself often comes to the tables to ask whether her guests are satisfied.
Harganya juga masuk akal: saya membayar tiga puluh lima ribu untuk makan siang dan es jeruk.
The prices are reasonable too: I paid thirty-five thousand for lunch and a glass of iced orange juice.
Kekurangannya, warung ini sangat ramai pada jam makan siang, dan tidak ada tempat parkir.
The downside is that the place is very crowded at lunchtime, and there is no parking.
Kalau Anda tidak suka menunggu, datanglah sebelum pukul dua belas.
If you don't like waiting, come before twelve.
Nilai saya: empat dari lima.
My rating: four out of five.

passages.title: Belajar bahasa asing sebagai orang dewasa
sentences: Banyak orang percaya bahwa hanya anak-anak yang bisa belajar bahasa asing dengan mudah.
Many people believe that only children can learn a foreign language easily.
Memang benar bahwa anak kecil biasanya lebih cepat meniru suara dan cara bicara orang lain.
It is true that small children usually copy other people's sounds and way of speaking more quickly.
Namun, orang dewasa juga punya kelebihan.
However, adults also have advantages.
Mereka sudah tahu cara belajar, bisa memahami aturan tata bahasa, dan biasanya punya tujuan yang jelas, misalnya untuk pekerjaan atau perjalanan.
They already know how to learn, can understand grammar rules, and usually have a clear goal, for example for work or travel.
Ibu Lestari, seorang guru bahasa Jepang di Bandung, mengajar banyak murid berumur di atas empat puluh tahun.
Mrs Lestari, a Japanese teacher in Bandung, teaches many students over forty.
Menurut dia, masalah terbesar orang dewasa bukan otak mereka, tetapi rasa malu.
In her opinion, adults' biggest problem is not their brains but embarrassment.
"Mereka takut membuat kesalahan di depan orang lain, jadi mereka jarang berbicara," katanya.
"They are afraid of making mistakes in front of others, so they rarely speak," she said.
Dia menyarankan murid-muridnya untuk berlatih sedikit setiap hari, mendengarkan lagu atau menonton film, dan tidak khawatir tentang kesalahan kecil.
She advises her students to practise a little every day, listen to songs or watch films, and not worry about small mistakes.
"Yang penting bukan umur, tetapi kebiasaan," katanya.
"What matters is not age but habit," she said.

questions.q: Menurut teks ini, orang dewasa tidak punya kelebihan dalam belajar bahasa.
questions.en: According to this text, adults have no advantages in learning languages.

questions.q: Apa kelebihan orang dewasa?
questions.en: What is one advantage adults have?

questions.en: According to Mrs Lestari, what is adults' biggest problem?

questions.en: Adult students are often afraid of making mistakes.

questions.q: Ibu Lestari menyarankan belajar lama, hanya satu kali seminggu.
questions.en: Mrs Lestari recommends studying for a long time, only once a week.

passages.title: Sepuluh tahun lagi
sentences: Guru bahasa Indonesia kami meminta setiap murid menulis tentang kehidupan mereka sepuluh tahun lagi.
Our Indonesian teacher asked every pupil to write about their life ten years from now.
Ini tulisan saya.
This is my piece.
Sepuluh tahun lagi, saya akan berumur dua puluh tujuh tahun.
In ten years I will be twenty-seven.
Saya harap saya sudah lulus dari universitas dan bekerja sebagai dokter hewan, karena sejak kecil saya sangat menyukai binatang.
I hope I will have graduated from university and be working as a vet, because I have loved animals since I was small.
Mungkin saya akan tinggal di sebuah kota kecil dekat gunung, bukan di Jakarta, karena saya tidak suka kemacetan dan udara yang kotor.
Maybe I will live in a small town near the mountains, not in Jakarta, because I don't like traffic jams and dirty air.
Saya ingin punya rumah sederhana dengan kebun, dua anjing, dan beberapa ekor ayam.
I want to have a simple house with a garden, two dogs and a few chickens.
Saya juga ingin berbicara tiga bahasa: bahasa Indonesia, bahasa Inggris, dan bahasa Korea.
I also want to speak three languages: Indonesian, English and Korean.
Tentu saja saya tidak tahu apakah semua rencana ini akan menjadi kenyataan.
Of course I don't know whether all these plans will come true.
Tetapi saya yakin bahwa kalau saya berusaha keras, sebagian besar mimpi saya bisa tercapai.
But I am sure that if I work hard, most of my dreams can come true.
Yang paling penting, saya ingin keluarga saya sehat dan bahagia.
Most importantly, I want my family to be healthy and happy.

passages.title: Pesan dari Dewi
sentences: Halo Rina, apa kabar? Aku sungguh senang kemarin kita bisa berjumpa lagi.
Hi Rina, how are you? I was really happy that we could meet again yesterday.
Semalam aku tidak bisa tidur karena masih memikirkan banyak hal.
Last night I couldn't sleep because I was still thinking about many things.
Kamu betul, aku harus lebih memperhatikan kesehatanku.
You're right, I have to pay more attention to my health.
Jadi mulai hari ini aku bangun lebih awal dan berjalan di bukit dekat rumah.
So from today I get up earlier and walk on the hill near my house.
Udaranya bersih dan langit masih cerah.
The air is clean and the sky is still clear.
Latihan kecil seperti ini sudah membuat badanku terasa lebih kuat.
A small exercise like this already makes my body feel stronger.
Minggu depan, mau ikut? Kamu tidak usah membawa apa-apa, cukup memakai sepatu yang nyaman.
Next week, do you want to join? You don't need to bring anything, just wear comfortable shoes.
Kalau kamu mau, bilang saja, ya.
If you want to, just say so.
Satu lagi, tiap pagi aku juga mendengarkan lagu favoritku.
One more thing, every morning I also listen to my favourite song.
Sampai jumpa, Dewi!
See you, Dewi!

questions.en: Why couldn't Dewi sleep last night?
options: Ada suara keras di luar rumah

passages.title: Salju pertama
sentences: Hari ini aku melihat salju untuk pertama kali dalam hidupku.
Today I saw snow for the first time in my life.
Kami sedang berlibur di Jepang, dan pagi tadi langit tampak putih.
We are on holiday in Japan, and this morning the sky looked white.
Di sini sangat dingin, jadi aku mengenakan jaket, celana panjang, dan sepatu yang hangat.
It is very cold here, so I wore a jacket, long trousers and warm shoes.
Adikku langsung berlari keluar dan melempar salju ke arahku.
My little brother ran straight outside and threw snow at me.
Kami tertawa sampai perut kami sakit.
We laughed until our stomachs hurt.
Setelah itu, kami membuat boneka salju di depan hotel.
After that we made a snowman in front of the hotel.
Sore harinya, kami minum cokelat panas dan melihat hujan salju dari jendela.
In the afternoon we drank hot chocolate and watched the snowfall from the window.
Malam hari langit menjadi cerah, dan kami bisa melihat banyak bintang.
At night the sky became clear, and we could see many stars.
Ibu bilang bintang di sini tampak lebih dekat daripada bintang di Jakarta.
Mum said the stars here look closer than the stars in Jakarta.
Aku ingin hari ini tidak cepat berlalu.
I wish this day wouldn't pass quickly.

questions.en: Why did the writer wear warm clothes?

questions.en: They made a snowman inside the hotel.

questions.q: Apa kata Ibu tentang bintang di sana?
questions.en: What did Mum say about the stars there?

passages.title: Naik ke bukit
sentences: Hari Sabtu, kami berangkat sangat pagi ke sebuah bukit kecil di dekat kota.
On Saturday we set off early in the morning to a small hill near the city.
Menurut peta, jarak dari tempat parkir ke puncak sekitar dua ribu meter.
According to the map, the distance from the car park to the top is about two thousand metres.
Di bagian yang tinggi, ada tangga dari batu.
In the higher part there are stone steps.
Kami harus hati-hati karena tangganya masih basah setelah hujan semalam.
We had to be careful because the steps were still wet after last night's rain.
Ayah berjalan dengan langkah yang kecil, dan setiap sepuluh menit kami berhenti untuk mengatur napas.
Dad walked with small steps, and every ten minutes we stopped to catch our breath.
Adik saya tidak suka berjalan, jadi dia bertanya terus, "Masih jauh, tidak?"
My little brother doesn't like walking, so he kept asking, "Is it still far?"
Ayah hanya tersenyum dan berkata bahwa kami tidak perlu cepat, kita santai saja.
Dad just smiled and said we didn't need to hurry, we'd take it easy.
Dua jam kemudian, kami sampai di puncak.
Two hours later we reached the top.
Dari atas, kota tampak kecil, dan langit terasa dekat sekali.
From up there the city looked small, and the sky felt very close.
Kami makan roti dan buah, lalu turun lagi sebelum sore.
We ate bread and fruit, then went back down before the afternoon.

questions.q: Seberapa jauh jarak dari tempat parkir ke puncak?
questions.en: How far is it from the car park to the top?

questions.q: Tangga di bukit itu sudah kering waktu mereka naik.

questions.en: Why did they stop often?

questions.en: Dad wanted to get to the top quickly.

questions.q: Bagaimana kota tampak dari puncak?
questions.en: How did the city look from the top?

passages.title: Jatuh dari sepeda
sentences: Kemarin sore saya mengalami kecelakaan kecil di jalan dekat rumah.
Yesterday afternoon I had a small accident on the road near my house.
Saya naik sepeda dengan kecepatan tinggi karena ingin cepat pulang.
I rode my bicycle at high speed because I wanted to get home quickly.
Tiba-tiba seekor kucing lari ke jalan, dan saya tidak sempat berhenti.
Suddenly a cat ran onto the road, and I had no time to stop.
Sepeda saya jatuh, dan saya terlempar ke jalanan.
My bicycle fell, and I was thrown onto the road.
Jalannya kosong, jadi tidak ada mobil yang lewat.
The road was empty, so no cars came by.
Kaki saya sakit, dan kulit di tangan kiri saya luka.
My leg hurt, and the skin on my left hand was wounded.
Seorang bapak di dekat situ membantu saya berdiri dan membawa saya ke rumah sakit kecil.
A man nearby helped me stand up and took me to a small hospital.
Dokter berkata bahwa luka itu tidak berbahaya dan akan sembuh dalam beberapa hari.
The doctor said that the wound was not dangerous and would heal in a few days.
Sekarang saya lebih hati-hati, dan saya tidak lagi naik sepeda terlalu cepat.
Now I am more careful, and I no longer ride my bicycle too fast.
Kucing itu sendiri tidak terluka sama sekali.
The cat itself was not hurt at all.

questions.q: Mengapa penulis jatuh dari sepeda?
questions.en: Why did the writer fall off the bicycle?
options: Ada hewan kecil di depan sepedanya

questions.q: Penulis naik sepeda dengan kecepatan rendah.
questions.en: The writer rode the bicycle at low speed.

questions.q: Ada banyak mobil di jalan itu.
questions.en: There were many cars on the road.
