questions.en: What did the doctor say about the wound?

questions.q: Sekarang penulis lebih hati-hati di jalan.
questions.en: Now the writer is more careful on the road.

passages.title: Perpustakaan kota
sentences: Pengumuman untuk semua anggota Perpustakaan Kota.
Announcement for all members of the City Library.
Mulai bulan depan, perpustakaan buka setiap hari dari pukul delapan pagi sampai pukul enam sore.
From next month the library is open every day from eight in the morning until six in the evening.
Lokasinya tetap di sebelah pasar, tetapi pintu masuk pindah ke sisi kiri bangunan.
The location stays next to the market, but the entrance moves to the left side of the building.
Anak-anak boleh membaca novel dan koran terbaru di ruang baca yang baru.
Children may read novels and the latest newspapers in the new reading room.
Setiap anggota boleh meminjam lima buku selama dua minggu.
Each member may borrow five books for two weeks.
Menurut peraturan baru, semua buku harus dikembalikan tepat waktu.
According to the new rules, all books must be returned on time.
Kalau terlambat, anggota harus membayar seribu rupiah untuk setiap hari.
If you are late, the member must pay one thousand rupiah for each day.
Kami mohon semua anggota tidak membawa makanan atau botol minum ke ruang baca.
We ask all members not to bring food or drink bottles into the reading room.
Untuk mengetahui jadwal acara, silakan tulis alamat email Anda di kertas di meja depan.
To find out the event schedule, please write your email address on the paper at the front desk.
Terima kasih atas perhatian Anda.
Thank you for your attention.

questions.q: Di mana pintu masuk perpustakaan yang baru?
questions.en: Where is the library's new entrance?

questions.q: Setiap anggota boleh meminjam sepuluh buku.
questions.en: Each member may borrow ten books.

questions.q: Apa yang tidak boleh dibawa ke ruang baca?
questions.en: What may not be brought into the reading room?

questions.q: Anggota yang terlambat tidak perlu membayar apa-apa.
questions.en: A member who is late does not have to pay anything.

questions.q: Apa yang harus ditulis anggota di kertas?
questions.en: What should members write on the paper?

passages.title: Wawancara dengan pelatih
sentences: Pak Joko adalah pelatih tim bola anak-anak di desa kami.
Pak Joko is the coach of the children's football team in our village.
Kami bertanya, "Apakah Bapak punya rahasia sukses?"
We asked, "Do you have a secret to success?"
Beliau tertawa dan menjawab, "Tidak ada rahasia, hanya latihan setiap minggu."
He laughed and answered, "There is no secret, only training every week."
Menurut Pak Joko, kemampuan anak itu penting, tetapi sikap mereka lebih penting.
According to Pak Joko, a child's ability is important, but their attitude is more important.
"Anak yang berani mencoba akan cepat belajar, walaupun dia sering gagal."
"A child who dares to try will learn quickly, even if he often fails."
Kami bertanya lagi tentang pertandingan terakhir, karena tim mereka kalah.
We asked again about the last match, because their team lost.
"Saya tidak marah," katanya.
"I'm not angry," he said.
Setiap Sabtu, semua anak berkumpul di lapangan dan berlatih selama dua jam.
Every Saturday all the children gather on the field and train for two hours.
Pak Joko mengatakan bahwa orang tua juga perlu sabar dan tidak menyalahkan anak mereka.
Pak Joko said that parents also need to be patient and not blame their children.
Harapannya sederhana: anak-anak senang bermain dan menjadi orang yang jujur.
His hope is simple: the children enjoy playing and become honest people.

questions.q: Menurut Pak Joko, apa yang penting untuk tim?
questions.en: According to Pak Joko, what matters for the team?

questions.q: Apa yang lebih penting daripada kemampuan?
questions.en: What is more important than ability?

questions.q: Pak Joko sangat marah setelah tim itu kalah.
questions.en: Pak Joko was very angry after the team lost.

questions.q: Menurut Pak Joko, anak yang takut mencoba cepat belajar.
questions.en: According to Pak Joko, a child who is afraid to try learns quickly.

questions.q: Apa harapan Pak Joko untuk anak-anak?
questions.en: What does Pak Joko hope for the children?

passages.title: Kue kacang Nenek
sentences: Hari ini Nenek mengajar saya membuat kue kacang.
Today Grandma is teaching me to make peanut cake.
Setelah semua bahan lengkap, Nenek mulai bekerja: dua gelas gula, tiga telur, dan sedikit susu.
Once all the ingredients were complete, Grandma started working: two glasses of sugar, three eggs and a little milk.
Nenek tidak memakai alat apa pun, dia hanya menghitung bahan dengan jari.
Grandma doesn't use any tool, she just counts the ingredients with her fingers.
"Jangan terlalu banyak gula," kata Nenek, "nanti kuenya terlalu manis."
"Not too much sugar," said Grandma, "or the cake will be too sweet."
Saya mencampur semuanya di atas piring besar, lalu menaruh kacang di atasnya.
I mixed everything on a big plate, then put the peanuts on top.
Setelah itu, Nenek memindahkan isi piring itu ke tempat kue.
After that Grandma moved the contents of the plate into a cake tin.
Kue itu harus dimasak selama tiga puluh menit dengan api kecil.
The cake has to cook for thirty minutes on a low flame.
Tidak lama kemudian, bau manis memenuhi seluruh rumah.
Before long, a sweet smell filled the whole house.
Kami makan kue itu waktu masih hangat, dengan teh panas.
We ate the cake while it was still warm, with hot tea.
Ayah bilang rasanya sama seperti kue masa kecilnya.
Dad said it tasted just like the cake of his childhood.

questions.q: Apa yang Nenek ajarkan hari ini?
questions.en: What is Grandma teaching today?

questions.q: Nenek memakai alat khusus untuk mengukur bahan.
questions.en: Grandma uses a special tool to measure the ingredients.

questions.q: Apa yang saya taruh di atas bahan-bahan itu?
questions.en: What did I put on top of the ingredients?

questions.q: Bau kue itu memenuhi seluruh rumah.
questions.en: The smell of the cake filled the whole house.

questions.q: Apa kata Ayah tentang kue itu?
questions.en: What did Dad say about the cake?
options: Rasanya seperti kue dari masa kecilnya
Dia tidak terlalu suka kacang di dalam kue

passages.title: Jembatan baru
sentences: Kemarin, sebuah jembatan baru dibuka di desa Sumber Jaya.
Yesterday a new bridge was opened in the village of Sumber Jaya.
Jembatan itu panjangnya seratus meter dan dibuat dari besi.
The bridge is one hundred metres long and made of iron.
Sebelumnya, penduduk desa harus berjalan dua jam untuk sampai ke kota.
Before, the villagers had to walk for two hours to reach the city.
Kepala desa membuka jembatan itu secara resmi, dan banyak orang hadir.
The village head opened the bridge officially, and many people attended.
Beliau berkata bahwa jembatan ini akan membantu masyarakat di kedua sisi sungai.
He said that this bridge would help the community on both sides of the river.
Anak-anak sekolah tidak akan terlambat lagi, dan truk sayur bisa lewat dengan lancar.
School children will no longer be late, and vegetable trucks can pass smoothly.
Seorang ibu mengatakan bahwa dulu dia sering takut karena air sungai sering naik setelah hujan besar.
A woman said that she used to be afraid often because the river water often rose after heavy rain.
Warga membangun jembatan itu selama sepuluh bulan, dan pekerjaan itu memerlukan banyak tenaga.
The residents built the bridge over ten months, and the work needed a lot of effort.
Mulai minggu depan, jembatan itu juga terbuka untuk motor dan sepeda setiap hari.
From next week the bridge will also be open to motorbikes and bicycles every day.
Penduduk berharap jalan menuju desa sebelah juga segera diperbaiki.
The residents hope the road to the next village will also be repaired soon.

questions.q: Dari apa jembatan itu dibuat?
questions.en: What is the bridge made of?

questions.q: Jembatan itu dibuka oleh seorang anak sekolah.
questions.en: The bridge was opened by a school child.

questions.q: Apa yang berubah bagi anak-anak sekolah?
questions.en: What changes for school children?
options: Mereka libur lebih lama daripada biasanya

questions.q: Warga membangun jembatan itu hanya dalam satu bulan.
questions.en: The residents built the bridge in only one month.

questions.q: Siapa yang boleh memakai jembatan itu minggu depan?
questions.en: Who may use the bridge next week?

passages.title: Hari pertama di sekolah baru
sentences: Hari ini adalah hari pertama Dina di sekolah baru.
Today is Dina's first day at her new school.
Dia agak takut karena belum punya kawan di sana.
She is a bit scared because she doesn't have any friends there yet.
Sebelum pelajaran dimulai, seorang siswa laki-laki, Tomi, bertanya, "Kamu dari mana?"
Before the lesson started, a boy student, Tomi, asked, "Where are you from?"
Tomi ternyata sangat ramah, dan dia menunjukkan kelas, perpustakaan, dan tempat makan siang.
Tomi turned out to be very friendly, and he showed her the classroom, the library and the lunch place.
Dalam pelajaran bahasa Inggris, guru meminta setiap siswa menulis satu kalimat tentang hobinya.
In the English lesson the teacher asked every student to write one sentence about their hobby.
Dina menulis di buku catatannya dengan huruf yang bagus.
Dina wrote in her notebook in nice letters.
Lalu dia membaca kalimatnya dengan keras dan mengucapkan setiap kata dengan hati-hati.
Then she read her sentence aloud and pronounced every word carefully.
Guru tersenyum dan berkata, "Bagus sekali! Kamu sangat pandai."
The teacher smiled and said, "Very good! You are very clever."
Waktu pulang, Tomi bilang, "Sampai besok, ya."
When it was time to go home, Tomi said, "See you tomorrow."
Dina tersenyum, karena sekarang dia sudah punya satu kawan baru.
Dina smiled, because now she had a new friend.

questions.q: Mengapa Dina agak takut?
questions.en: Why is Dina a bit scared?

questions.q: Tomi bertanya kepada Dina dari mana dia datang.
questions.en: Tomi asked Dina where she came from.

questions.q: Apa yang guru minta dalam pelajaran bahasa Inggris?
questions.en: What did the teacher ask for in the English lesson?
options: Tulisan pendek tentang hal yang dia suka

questions.q: Dina membaca kalimatnya dengan pelan, hampir tanpa suara.
questions.en: Dina read her sentence slowly, almost silently.

questions.q: Apa kata guru tentang Dina?
questions.en: What did the teacher say about Dina?

passages.title: Liburan di kebun Paman
sentences: Halo Fajar, sekarang aku sedang libur di kebun besar milik Paman.
Hi Fajar, right now I'm on holiday at Uncle's big farm.
Paman punya sapi, kuda, dan banyak ayam.
Uncle has cows, horses and many chickens.
Setiap pagi aku membantu Paman memberi makan sapi.
Every morning I help Uncle feed the cows.
Sapi-sapi itu besar, tetapi mereka tidak jahat.
The cows are big, but they are not mean.
Kuda Paman, si Bintang, punya bulu yang hitam dan bagus.
Uncle's horse, Bintang, has a black and beautiful coat.
Kemarin aku menaiki kuda itu untuk pertama kali.
Yesterday I rode that horse for the first time.
Awalnya aku takut, tetapi Paman memegang tanganku sampai aku berani.
At first I was afraid, but Uncle held my hand until I felt brave.
Sore hari, burung-burung terbang rendah di atas kebun.
In the afternoon, birds fly low over the garden.
Malam hari di sini sangat tenang, tidak ada suara mobil, hanya suara binatang.
The nights here are very calm, there is no sound of cars, only the sound of animals.
Kalau kamu datang, bawa pakaian lama, karena kita akan kotor setiap hari!
If you come, bring old clothes, because we'll get dirty every day!

questions.q: Binatang apa yang Paman punya?
questions.en: What animals does Uncle have?

questions.q: Aku membantu Paman dengan memberi sapi-sapi makanan setiap pagi.
questions.en: I help Uncle by feeding the cows every morning.

questions.q: Aku tidak takut waktu pertama kali naik kuda.
questions.en: I wasn't afraid the first time I rode the horse.

questions.q: Apa yang terbang di atas kebun sore hari?
questions.en: What flies over the garden in the afternoon?

questions.q: Mengapa Fajar harus membawa pakaian lama?
questions.en: Why must Fajar bring old clothes?

passages.title: Makan malam di pantai
sentences: Pada malam ulang tahun ibunya, Ratna mengajak keluarganya makan di sebuah restoran baru di dekat pantai.
On the evening of her mother's birthday, Ratna took her family to eat at a new restaurant near the beach.
Pelayan memberikan menu yang tebal, dan semua orang butuh waktu lama untuk memilih.
The waiter handed over a thick menu, and everyone needed a long time to choose.
Ayah memesan ikan panggang, dan Ibu ingin sayuran dan kentang.
Dad ordered grilled fish, and Mum wanted vegetables and potatoes.
Setengah jam kemudian, pesanan mereka belum datang, dan adik Ratna mulai kesal.
Half an hour later their order had not come, and Ratna's little brother started to get annoyed.
Akhirnya pelayan datang membawa mangkuk besar, tetapi rupanya itu bukan pesanan mereka.
Finally the waiter came with a big bowl, but it turned out it was not their order.
Dia kaget, lalu minta maaf dan berjanji membawa makanan yang benar segera.
He was shocked, then apologised and promised to bring the right food as soon as possible.
Ketika ikan itu tiba, aromanya enak, tetapi dagingnya masih mentah di bagian tengah.
When the fish arrived, the aroma was good, but the flesh was still raw in the middle.
Ayah memanggil pelayan itu dengan sopan dan menjelaskan masalahnya.
Dad called the waiter politely and explained the problem.
Tidak lama kemudian, pemilik restoran membawa ikan baru yang matang sempurna.
Before long, the owner of the restaurant brought a new fish that was perfectly cooked.
Selera makan Ibu kembali, dan dia berkata bahwa masakan itu salah satu yang terbaik tahun ini.
Mum's appetite came back, and she said the cooking was one of the best this year.
Saat menerima tagihan, Ratna kebetulan melihat bahwa harga ikan pertama sudah dihapus.
When receiving the bill, Ratna happened to see that the price of the first fish had been removed.
Dia membayar tunai, memberi uang tambahan untuk pelayan itu, dan pulang dengan senyum.
She paid in cash, gave extra money to the waiter, and went home with a smile.

questions.q: Mengapa semua orang lama memilih makanan?
questions.en: Why did everyone take a long time to choose food?

questions.q: Pesanan keluarga Ratna datang dengan cepat.
questions.en: The order of Ratna's family came quickly.

questions.q: Mengapa pelayan itu minta maaf?
questions.en: Why did the waiter apologise?

questions.q: Apa masalah ikan pertama?
questions.en: What was the problem with the first fish?
options: Rasanya terlalu manis dan terlalu panas

questions.q: Keluarga Ratna harus membayar harga untuk kedua ikan.
questions.en: Ratna's family had to pay for both fish.

passages.title: Surat untuk Bapak Hartono
sentences: Kepada Yth. Bapak Hartono,
To Mr Hartono,
Saya membaca lowongan untuk jabatan asisten laboratorium di perusahaan Bapak, dan saya sangat ingin bekerja di sana.
I read the vacancy for the position of laboratory assistant at your company, and I would really like to work there.
Nama saya Sinta, dan saya baru lulus dari jurusan kimia di sebuah universitas di Bandung.
My name is Sinta, and I have just graduated from the chemistry department of a university in Bandung.
Selama kuliah, saya bekerja paruh waktu di laboratorium kampus dan belajar mencatat hasil kerja dengan rapi.
During my studies I worked part-time in the campus laboratory and learned to note down results neatly.
Saya juga mengikuti kursus bahasa Inggris, sehingga saya bisa membaca teks ilmiah tanpa kesulitan.
I also took an English course, so I can read scientific texts without difficulty.
Menurut atasan saya yang lama, saya cepat belajar dan mau bekerja sama dengan karyawan lain.
According to my former boss, I learn quickly and am willing to work together with other employees.
Saya mengerti bahwa pekerjaan ini bisa melelahkan, tetapi saya siap bekerja dengan jadwal yang berubah.
I understand that this work can be tiring, but I am ready to work on a changing schedule.
Kalau ada contoh kontrak kerja yang bisa saya baca sebelum wawancara, saya akan sangat berterima kasih.
If there is a sample work contract I can read before the interview, I would be very grateful.
Data diri dan nilai saya ada di berkas yang saya kirim bersama email ini.
My personal details and grades are in the file I am sending with this email.
Saya siap datang kapan saja untuk wawancara.
I am ready to come at any time for an interview.
Atas perhatian Bapak, saya ucapkan terima kasih.
I thank you for your attention.
Hormat saya, Sinta.
Yours respectfully, Sinta.

questions.q: Jabatan apa yang Sinta inginkan?
questions.en: What position does Sinta want?

questions.q: Sinta sudah lama bekerja sebagai dosen kimia.
questions.en: Sinta has long worked as a chemistry lecturer.

questions.q: Mengapa Sinta bisa membaca teks ilmiah bahasa Inggris?
questions.en: Why can Sinta read English scientific texts?

questions.q: Atasannya yang lama berkata bahwa Sinta cepat belajar.
questions.en: Her former boss said that Sinta learns quickly.

questions.q: Apa yang Sinta kirim bersama email itu?
questions.en: What did Sinta send with the email?

passages.title: Terlambat ke bandara
sentences: Dimas harus terbang ke Medan untuk urusan kerja, dan pesawatnya berangkat pukul tujuh pagi.
Dimas had to fly to Medan for work, and his plane left at seven in the morning.
Sayangnya, taksi yang dia pesan datang telat, dan jalan menuju bandara penuh mobil.
Unfortunately the taxi he ordered came late, and the road to the airport was full of cars.
Ketika akhirnya tiba, Dimas berlari ke meja petugas sambil menarik kopernya.
When he finally arrived, Dimas ran to the officer's desk while pulling his suitcase.
Petugas memeriksa paspornya dan berkata bahwa pintu pesawat akan segera ditutup.
The officer checked his passport and said that the plane door would close soon.
Dia melewati pemeriksaan dengan cepat, tetapi masih harus berjalan jauh ke gerbang nomor dua belas.
He went through the security check quickly, but still had to walk far to gate number twelve.
Di sana terdengar pengumuman bahwa penumpang terakhir diminta naik.
There an announcement could be heard that the last passengers were asked to board.
Dimas masuk ke pesawat dengan napas yang cepat dan wajah yang merah.
Dimas entered the plane out of breath and with a red face.
Dia duduk di sebelah seorang pemandu wisata yang baru pulang dari tur ke Bali.
He sat next to a tour guide who had just come back from a tour to Bali.
Pemandu itu tertawa dan berkata bahwa hampir semua orang pernah telat ke bandara.
The guide laughed and said that almost everybody has been late to the airport.
Pilot memberitahu penumpang bahwa cuaca baik dan mereka akan mendarat tepat waktu.
The pilot told the passengers that the weather was good and they would land on time.
Sejak hari itu, Dimas selalu berangkat satu jam lebih awal dan tidak pernah menyalahkan sopir taksi lagi.
From that day Dimas always leaves an hour earlier and never blames taxi drivers again.

questions.q: Mengapa Dimas hampir terlambat naik pesawat?
questions.en: Why was Dimas almost too late to board his plane?

questions.q: Dimas harus berjalan sangat jauh sebelum sampai di gerbang.
questions.en: Dimas had to walk very far before he reached the gate.

questions.q: Siapa yang duduk di sebelah Dimas?
questions.en: Who sat next to Dimas?

questions.q: Pilot berkata bahwa pesawat akan mendarat terlambat.
questions.en: The pilot said the plane would land late.

questions.q: Apa yang Dimas lakukan setelah kejadian itu?
questions.en: What did Dimas do after the incident?
options: Dia pindah ke Bali bersama pemandu

passages.title: Pusing dan lemah
sentences: Sudah tiga hari Arif merasa pusing, dan badannya terasa agak panas.
For three days Arif had felt dizzy, and his body felt a bit hot.
Pagi ini badannya juga terasa lemah, jadi dia memutuskan pergi ke dokter.
This morning his body also felt weak, so he decided to go to the doctor.
Di ruang tunggu, semua orang memakai masker, dan Arif juga mengambil satu.
In the waiting room everyone wore a mask, and Arif took one too.
Dokter menanyakan gejalanya, lalu melakukan pemeriksaan singkat.
The doctor asked about his symptoms, then did a short examination.
"Apakah Anda punya alergi?" tanya dokter.
"Do you have an allergy?" asked the doctor.
Arif menjawab bahwa dia alergi debu, dan di kantornya memang banyak debu karena sedang diperbaiki.
Arif answered that he was allergic to dust, and in his office there was indeed a lot of dust because it was being repaired.
Dokter berkata bahwa sakitnya mungkin bukan karena infeksi, tetapi karena alergi yang makin kuat.
The doctor said his illness might not be due to an infection, but to an allergy that was getting stronger.
Pengobatannya sederhana: obat tiga kali sehari, banyak air putih, dan istirahat.
The treatment was simple: medicine three times a day, lots of water, and rest.
Dokter juga menyarankan Arif memakai masker di kantor sampai pekerjaan itu selesai.
The doctor also advised Arif to wear a mask at the office until the work was finished.
"Jangan bekerja terlalu keras, supaya badan Anda cepat pulih," katanya.
"Don't work too hard, so that your body recovers quickly," he said.
Dua hari kemudian, pusing dan keringat dinginnya hilang, dan Arif merasa jauh lebih baik.
Two days later the dizziness and cold sweat were gone, and Arif felt much better.
Dia berjanji akan pergi ke dokter lebih cepat kalau gejala itu muncul lagi.
He promised to go to the doctor sooner if the symptoms appeared again.

questions.q: Apa yang Arif ambil di ruang tunggu?
questions.en: What did Arif take in the waiting room?

questions.q: Arif punya alergi terhadap debu.
questions.en: Arif has an allergy to dust.

questions.q: Karena apa Arif sakit, menurut dokter?
questions.en: What is Arif ill from, according to the doctor?
options: Infeksi berat yang sudah lama ada

questions.q: Pengobatannya sulit dan harus di rumah sakit.
questions.en: The treatment was difficult and had to be done in hospital.

questions.q: Apa yang terjadi dua hari kemudian?
questions.en: What happened two days later?

passages.title: Setelah banjir
sentences: Hujan besar turun selama tiga hari, dan air sungai naik sampai menjadi banjir di kampung kami.
Heavy rain fell for three days, and the river water rose until it became a flood in our village.
Air masuk ke banyak rumah, dan arusnya begitu kencang sehingga orang tidak bisa berjalan di jalan.
Water entered many houses, and the current was so strong that people could not walk on the road.
Warga membawa anak-anak dan orang tua ke gedung sekolah yang lebih tinggi.
The residents took children and old people to the school building, which was higher.
Kami hanya sempat membawa kasur, bantal, dan beberapa pakaian.
We only had time to bring mattresses, pillows and a few clothes.
Pada hari kedua, bantuan pertama datang dari kampung sebelah.
On the second day, the first help came from the next village.
Komunitas pemuda membuka gudang mereka dan memberi beras dan sayuran kepada semua orang.
The youth community opened their storeroom and gave rice and vegetables to everyone.
Semua orang tahu bahwa kebutuhan paling penting adalah air bersih.
Everyone knew that the most important need was clean water.
Kami bergantung pada tetangga, dan tidak ada yang bertanya siapa yang kaya atau miskin.
We depended on our neighbours, and nobody asked who was rich or poor.
Ketika hujan akhirnya reda, air perlahan turun dan warga mulai membersihkan rumah.
When the rain finally stopped, the water slowly went down and the residents started cleaning their houses.
Pekerjaan itu berat, tetapi karena kami bersatu, semuanya selesai dalam seminggu.
The work was heavy, but because we were united, everything was done within a week.
Banjir adalah bencana, tetapi kami belajar bahwa bantuan datang kalau orang saling peduli.
A flood is a disaster, but we learned that help comes when people care for one another.

questions.q: Ke mana warga membawa anak-anak dan orang tua?
questions.en: Where did the residents take the children and old people?

questions.q: Mereka sempat membawa semua barang dari rumah.
questions.en: They had time to bring all their belongings from their houses.

questions.q: Siapa yang memberi beras dan sayuran kepada warga?
questions.en: Who gave rice and vegetables to the residents?

questions.q: Air bersih adalah hal yang paling dibutuhkan semua orang.
questions.en: Clean water is what everybody needs most.

questions.q: Berapa lama pekerjaan membersihkan rumah?
questions.en: How long did the cleaning of houses take?

passages.title: Grup musik sekolah
sentences: Tiga tahun lalu, Maya mendirikan klub musik di sekolahnya bersama empat temannya.
Three years ago Maya founded a music club at her school together with four friends.
Awalnya mereka hanya sekadar bermain untuk senang-senang.
At first they were just playing for fun.
Maya bermain piano, dan Putri adalah penyanyi dengan suara yang bagus.
Maya plays the piano, and Putri is a singer with a good voice.
Mereka menulis lirik sendiri, dan banyak lagu mereka berisi puisi tentang kehidupan mereka.
They write their own lyrics, and many of their songs contain poetry about their lives.
Setelah setahun, guru musik mereka melihat bakat besar di dalam grup itu.
After a year, their music teacher saw great talent in the group.
Dia menyarankan mereka mengikuti kompetisi musik antar-sekolah di kota.
He suggested they join the inter-school music competition in the city.
Mereka sempat gugup, tetapi nada pertama dari piano membuat semuanya tenang.
They were nervous for a while, but the first note from the piano calmed everyone.
Meskipun tidak menang, seseorang yang menonton mendengar lagu mereka dan menawarkan membuat rekaman.
Although they did not win, someone in the audience heard their song and offered to make a recording.
Sekarang mereka sudah punya satu album kecil dan beberapa penggemar yang selalu datang ke setiap konser.
Now they have a small album and some fans who come to every concert.
Maya berkata bahwa musik mengajarnya kerja sama dan keberanian.
Maya says that music taught her teamwork and courage.

questions.q: Siapa yang mendirikan klub musik itu?
questions.en: Who founded the music club?

questions.q: Putri memainkan piano di dalam grup itu.
questions.en: Putri plays the piano in the group.

questions.q: Apa yang dilihat guru musik pada grup itu?
questions.en: What did the music teacher see in the group?

questions.q: Apa yang terjadi setelah kompetisi?
questions.en: What happened after the competition?
options: Mereka menang hadiah pertama di kota itu

questions.q: Grup itu sudah punya album dan penggemar.
questions.en: The group already has an album and fans.

passages.title: Laptop yang mati
sentences: Pada Senin pagi, laptop Bagas tiba-tiba mati, padahal dia harus mengirim laporan sebelum siang.
On Monday morning Bagas's laptop suddenly died, even though he had to send a report before noon.
Dia mencoba menyalakannya beberapa kali, tetapi layarnya tetap gelap.
He tried to turn it on several times, but the screen stayed dark.
Pertama, dia memeriksa kabel dan menukarnya dengan milik adiknya.
First he checked the cable and swapped it with his sibling's.
Hasilnya sama saja, jadi dia menghubungi layanan pelanggan di toko tempat dia membeli laptop itu.
The result was the same, so he contacted customer service at the shop where he bought the laptop.
Petugas menjelaskan beberapa langkah yang harus dicoba, dan salah satu solusinya mudah: menahan tombol daya selama sepuluh detik.
The staff member explained several steps to try, and one solution was easy: hold the power button for ten seconds.
Cara itu tidak berhasil, sehingga petugas menyarankan Bagas datang langsung ke toko.
That method did not work, so the staff member suggested Bagas come to the shop directly.
Di sana, mereka menemukan kerusakan pada perangkat kecil di dalam laptop itu.
There they found damage in a small device inside the laptop.
Laporan Bagas selesai tepat waktu karena dia meminjam laptop teman kantornya dan mengirim laporan itu lewat email.
Bagas's report was finished on time because he borrowed his office colleague's laptop and sent the report by email.
Dua hari kemudian, tagihan perbaikan hanya setengah harga karena toko masih menjamin laptop itu.
Two days later the repair bill was only half the price because the shop still guaranteed the laptop.
Sejak itu, Bagas menyimpan semua pekerjaannya secara otomatis di internet dan tidak lagi bergantung pada satu perangkat.
Since then Bagas saves all his work automatically on the internet and no longer depends on a single device.

passages.title: Kota tua yang berubah
sentences: Pak Hasan sudah tinggal di kota ini selama tujuh puluh tahun.
Pak Hasan has lived in this city for seventy years.
Menurut dia, perkembangan kota dalam dua puluh tahun terakhir lebih cepat daripada setengah abad sebelumnya.
According to him, the city's development in the last twenty years has been faster than in the half century before.
Populasi kota bertambah, dan jalan-jalan kecil sekarang penuh kendaraan.
The city's population has grown, and the small streets are now full of vehicles.
Dulu orang berbelanja di pasar lokal dengan tas dari bambu, tetapi sekarang banyak yang memakai kantong plastik.
In the past people shopped at the local market with bamboo bags, but now many use plastic bags.
Pemerintah kota baru membuat kebijakan untuk mengurangi sampah plastik di pasar.
The city government recently made a policy to reduce plastic waste in the market.
Pak Hasan senang, tetapi dia sedih karena generasi muda tidak lagi mengenal tradisi lama, seperti tari dan cerita rakyat.
Pak Hasan is glad, but he is sad because the younger generation no longer knows old traditions, such as dance and folk tales.
Di sisi lain, transportasi umum sekarang jauh lebih baik, dan banyak orang datang untuk wisata dari negara lain.
On the other hand, public transport is much better now, and many people come for tourism from other countries.
Pak Hasan kadang-kadang naik bis kota hanya untuk melihat perubahan itu dari jendela.
Pak Hasan sometimes takes the city bus just to watch the changes from the window.
Dia berharap kota ini tetap bisa menjaga lingkungannya dan tidak melupakan masa lalunya.
He hopes the city can keep looking after its environment and not forget its past.
Menurutnya, kemajuan yang baik adalah kemajuan yang tidak membuat orang lupa dari mana mereka datang.
In his view, good progress is progress that doesn't make people forget where they come from.

passages.title: Pernikahan sepupu
sentences: Minggu lalu, sepupu saya, Laila, menikah, dan seluruh keluarga besar sudah menerima undangan dua bulan sebelumnya.
Last week my cousin Laila got married, and the whole extended family had received an invitation two months earlier.
Ibu membeli gaun biru yang cantik, dan Ayah memakai jas yang sudah lama tidak dia pakai.
Mum bought a beautiful blue dress, and Dad wore a suit jacket he hadn't worn for a long time.
Adik laki-laki saya lebih suka memakai kemeja putih dan sarung hijau.
My little brother preferred wearing a white shirt and a green sarong.
Gedung pernikahan dihias dengan mawar merah muda dan lampu kecil di setiap sudut.
The wedding hall was decorated with pink roses and small lights in every corner.
Dua keponakan kembar Laila membawa bunga di depan pengantin, dan mereka tampak sangat rapi.
Laila's two twin nieces/nephews carried flowers in front of the bride and groom, and they looked very neat.
Kakek, yang sudah delapan puluh tahun, duduk di kursi depan dan menangis pelan ketika cucu pertamanya mengucapkan janji.
Grandfather, who is already eighty, sat in the front chair and cried quietly when his first grandchild spoke her vows.
Hidangan malam itu enak sekali: ada nasi kuning, ayam, dan kue manis.
The dishes that night were delicious: there was yellow rice, chicken and sweet cakes.
Banyak tamu mengambil foto dengan pengantin, lalu memberi salam kepada keluarga.
Many guests took photos with the couple, then greeted the family.
Saya merasa bersyukur karena bisa berkumpul dengan semua saudara setelah sekian lama.
I felt grateful to be able to gather with all my relatives after so long.
Kakek berpesan agar kami menjaga tradisi keluarga, termasuk datang bersama ketika ada acara besar.
Grandfather asked us to keep up the family tradition, including coming together when there is a big event.

passages.title: Seminggu di hutan
sentences: Ibu Anita adalah ilmuwan yang mempelajari serangga di hutan hujan.
Ibu Anita is a scientist who studies insects in the rainforest.
Setiap pagi dia berjalan ke dalam hutan dengan buku catatan, kamera, dan satu botol air.
Every morning she walks into the forest with a notebook, a camera and a bottle of water.
Dia mengamati lebah yang membuat sarang di pohon tua dan mencatat berapa kali mereka keluar dalam satu jam.
She observes bees that make a nest in an old tree and notes how many times they leave in an hour.
Dari sarang itu, penduduk desa mengambil madu, tetapi mereka tidak pernah mengambil semuanya.
From that nest the villagers take honey, but they never take all of it.
Di dekat sungai, Anita menemukan kupu-kupu dengan sayap biru yang menurutnya mungkin spesies baru.
Near the river Anita found a butterfly with blue wings that she thinks may be a new species.
Dia mengambil gambar daun-daun di sekitarnya dan menulis nama pohonnya.
She took pictures of the leaves around it and wrote down the name of the tree.
Suatu sore, seekor rusa muncul dan berdiri diam di dekat pohon kelapa, hanya beberapa meter dari dia.
One afternoon a deer appeared and stood still near a coconut tree, only a few metres from her.
Anita menahan napas supaya binatang itu tidak takut.
Anita held her breath so the animal would not be afraid.
Pada akhir minggu, dia sudah mengumpulkan banyak data, dan hasil penelitian itu akan terbit dalam sebuah artikel ilmiah.
At the end of the week she had collected a lot of data, and the research results will be published in a scientific article.
Menurutnya, hutan seperti ini adalah laboratorium alam yang harus dilindungi.
In her view, a forest like this is a natural laboratory that must be protected.
